summary.en: Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has dismissed concerns raised by Nationals leader Matt Canavan regarding the extent of powers granted to the communications minister under new digital duty of care legislation. Canavan criticized the bill, suggesting the minister would have excessive authority to dictate...
summary.zh: 澳大利亚总理阿尔巴尼斯驳斥了国家党领袖马特·卡纳万提出的担忧，即根据新的数字责任法案，通信部长将拥有过大的权力。卡纳万批评该法案，认为部长将有过度权力来规定平台的内容审核政策。阿尔巴尼斯反驳称卡纳万的批评是虚伪的，并强调该立法包含可被否决的条款，需经议会审查。

body.en: Follow the day’s news live Albanese dismisses concerns over powers in digital duty of care bill Anthony Albanese says the Nationals leader, Matt Canavan, is being “disingenuous” over his criticisms that the communications minister, Anika Wells, will have too much power to broaden the content that platforms will have to protect users from under the new digital duty of care legislation. The eSafety commissioner will of course provide the advice, but Matt Canavan actually knows that he’s being disingenuous because all of these things will be disallowable. That is, will be up to the whole parliament, like the other previous laws have been. Otherwise, what you’ve got to do in order to make a change, is to change the legislation, so to be coming forward over and over again. Continue reading...
body.zh: 安东尼·阿尔巴尼斯 (Anthony Albanese) 表示，国家党领袖马特·卡纳万 (Matt Canavan) 批评通讯部长阿尼卡·韦尔斯 (Anika Wells) 拥有太多权力，无法扩大平台在新的数字注意义务立法下保护用户免受影响的内容。电子安全专员当然会提供建议，但马特·卡纳万实际上知道他是不诚实的，因为所有这些事情都是不允许的。也就是说，将由整个议会决定，就像之前的其他法律一样。否则，为了做出改变，你必须做的就是改变立法，所以要一次又一次地挺身而出。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In the complex landscape of digital governance, questions arise about the balance of power and the potential for overreach. As leaders debate legislation, the core challenge remains to ensure that authority is exercised justly and with a commitment to the well-being of citizens. This calls for wisdom and integrity in decision-making, reflecting a desire for...
reflection.zh: 在复杂的数字治理格局中，关于权力的平衡和过度扩张的可能性引发了疑问。当领导人辩论立法时，核心挑战仍然是确保权力得到公正行使，并致力于公民的福祉。这需要智慧和正直的决策，反映出在技术如何影响社会方面对公平的渴望。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Two more people arrested over ‘mountain of illegal waste’ dumped in Oxfordshire
title.zh: 牛津郡发现“山一样非法废物”后逮捕两人

summary.en: Two men have been arrested as part of an ongoing investigation into a "mountain of illegal waste" discovered in Oxfordshire, stacked 10 meters high. This brings the total number of arrests to six. The clean-up operation for the hundreds of tonnes of waste is estimated to cost around £6 million, a figure that could...
summary.zh: 作为对在牛津郡发现的“山一样非法废物”的持续调查的一部分，有两人被逮捕。这些废物堆积高达10米。至此，被捕人数已达六人。清理这些数吨废物的行动估计耗资约600万英镑，这一数字可能超过当地议会的年度预算。

body.en: A total of six people apprehended as clean-up of rubbish stacked 10 metres high cost about £6m Two men have been arrested after fly-tippers dumped a “mountain of illegal waste”, stacked 10 metres high, in Oxfordshire . Hundreds of tonnes of waste appeared in a field between the River Cherwell and the A34 near Kidlington in November last year. The waste tip was so large that removing it could cost more than the local council’s annual budget, the area’s MP said. Continue reading...
body.zh: 清理堆积如山的 10 米高垃圾，耗资约 600 万英镑，共有 6 人被捕 牛津郡，飞卸者倾倒堆积如山的 10 米高垃圾后，两名男子被捕。去年 11 月，数百吨废物出现在基德灵顿附近的查韦尔河和 A34 公路之间的田地里。该地区的议员表示，垃圾场太大了，拆除它的成本可能超过当地议会的年度预算。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The discovery of a 10-meter-high mountain of illegal waste in Oxfordshire, with a clean-up cost of £6 million, speaks to a profound disregard for the environment and community well-being. This incident raises questions about accountability and the ethical stewardship of our shared spaces. The prophet Micah reminds us that true righteousness involves acting...
reflection.zh: 在牛津郡发现高达10米的非法废物堆，清理费用高达600万英镑，这反映出对环境和社区福祉的严重漠视。这一事件引发了关于问责制和我们共享空间伦理管理的疑问。先知弥迦提醒我们，真正的公义在于行公义、好怜悯、以及谦卑地与我们的雅伟同行，这些原则在面对如此疏忽的环境问题时显得尤为迫切。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

summary.en: A state senator is among politicians pushing back against the president's social media post suggesting New Mexico should be renamed 'New America.' Meanwhile, in New Hampshire, the Democratic primary for Chris Pappas's House seat features eight candidates, with Republicans seeing the traditionally Democratic district...
summary.zh: 州参议员是抨击总统社交媒体帖子、建议将新墨西哥州更名为“新美国”的政界人士之一。与此同时，在新罕布什尔州，克里斯·帕帕斯的众议院席位民主党初选有八名候选人，共和党人认为这个传统上属于民主党的选区有可能被翻转，唐纳德·特朗普已endorse了一位共和党候选人。

body.en: Last week the state’s supreme court ruled that the map must go before voters to approve or reject new districts, meaning it cannot be used in the November election Sign up for US Breaking News emails Further down the ballot in New Hampshire, the Democratic primary for Chris Pappas’s House seat has drawn eight candidates, with Stefany Shaheen – daughter of the outgoing senator – and Maura Sullivan , a former Obama administration official, leading the field. The district, long purple, has been reliably blue since 2017. Republicans now see it as flippable, and Donald Trump has endorsed Anthony DiLorenzo , a businessman who owns several car dealerships, in the GOP race. Continue reading...
body.zh: 政界人士中的州参议员回击总统的社交媒体帖子，称新墨西哥州应该改为“新美国”。在新罕布什尔州的投票中，克里斯·帕帕斯众议院席位的民主党初选已经吸引了八名候选人，其中即将卸任参议员的女儿斯蒂芬妮·沙欣和前奥巴马政府官员莫拉·沙利文领先。这个长紫色的选区自 2017 年以来一直是可靠的蓝色。共和党人现在认为它是可以翻转的，唐纳德·特朗普 (Donald Trump) 在共和党竞选中支持拥有多家汽车经销店的商人安东尼·迪洛伦佐 (Anthony DiLorenzo)。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Disputes over names and symbols, like the suggestion to rename New Mexico, often reflect deeper debates about national identity and values. Proverbs 14:34 reminds us that a nation's moral character is foundational to its flourishing. Political discourse can easily become a battle of egos, but the enduring health of a society depends on its commitment to...
reflection.zh: 关于名称和象征的争论，例如将新墨西哥州更名的提议，常常反映出对国家身份和价值观的更深层次辩论。《箴言》14:34 提醒我们，一个国家的道德品格是其繁荣的基础。政治言论很容易变成一场自负的较量，但社会的持久健康取决于其对公义的承诺。

verse.textEn: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin condemns any people.
verse.textZh: 公义使邦国高举；罪恶是人民的羞辱。

title.en: Paul Adams: British-Israeli relations at lowest ebb in decades
title.zh: 保罗·亚当斯：英以关系数十年来的最低点

summary.en: Israel's response to London's trade ban with Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank shows how important this moment is.
summary.zh: 以色列对伦敦禁止与约旦河西岸被占领土的以色列定居点进行贸易的禁令的反应，表明了这一时刻的重要性。

body.en:
Israel's furious response to the British government's decision to ban trade with Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank testifies to just how important this moment is.

Britain took the brunt of Israel's anger, but the fact that 12 countries chose to move together clearly sharpened the sense of outrage.

Officials in London always knew that such a dramatic shift in policy towards Israel-Palestine was going to elicit a hostile response, but seemed taken aback by the speed and ferocity of Israel's reaction.

The closure of the UK's consulate in East Jerusalem, which serves the West Bank and deals directly with the Palestinian Authority in Ramallah, and the removal of British representatives from the International Gaza Support Centre, the body set up last year to co-ordinate stabilisation and relief efforts in the Gaza Strip, are very hostile moves.

They tell you that Israel is deeply troubled by Tuesday's action by the UK and 11 other countries, which include France, Spain and Canada.

Products manufactured in settlements may not represent a significant proportion of Israel's exports, but the political symbolism of singling these out for special treatment is powerful.

For decades, the British and other governments have regarded settlements in occupied Palestinian territory as illegal but stopped short of banning products grown or manufactured there.

Now, having announced that Britain agrees with the 2024 International Court of Justice ruling that the occupation as a whole - including Israel's military presence - is unlawful, Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband says the government's economic relationships must reflect that.

Hence the ban, not just on products but also on companies that provide construction, infrastructure or finance to settlements. The measures, which also include restrictions on arms sales that "materially contribute to the occupation", go further than many expected.

And it's not just the actions - it's the language of the foreign secretary's heartfelt, sometimes deeply personal statement that is so striking.

As a "proud British Jew... unwavering in my support for the state of Israel," Miliband spoke more directly and starkly than practically any of his predecessors.

That a British foreign secretary should say that "settler terrorism is rampant" and was responsible for the "ethnic cleansing" of Palestinians in parts of the West Bank, while the Israeli government "turned a blind eye to this" is truly remarkable.

Miliband calls this a "reset" in British policy. At times today, it felt like a radical rethink, and it leaves British-Israeli relations at their lowest ebb for decades.

Yes, the heated, febrile atmosphere that invariably accompanies an impending Israeli election may have contributed to Israeli Foreign Minister Gideon...
body.zh: 以色列对英国政府禁止与被占领约旦河西岸以色列定居点进行贸易的决定做出强烈反应，这证明了这一时刻的重要性。 英国首当其冲地受到了以色列的愤怒，但12个国家选择共同行动的事实显然加剧了以色列的愤怒。 伦敦官员一直都知道，对以色列-巴勒斯坦政策的如此巨大转变将引发敌对反应，但他们似乎对以色列反应的速度和猛烈感到惊讶。 关闭为西岸服务并直接与拉马拉巴勒斯坦权力机构打交道的英国驻东耶路撒冷领事馆，以及从去年为协调加沙地带稳定和救援工作而设立的国际加沙支持中心中撤出英国代表，都是非常敌对的举动。 他们告诉你，以色列对英国和法国、西班牙和加拿大等其他 11 个国家周二的行动深感不安。 定居点制造的产品可能并不占以色列出口的很大一部分，但将这些产品单独挑选出来给予特殊待遇的政治象征意义是强大的。 几十年来，英国和其他国家政府一直将巴勒斯坦被占领土上的定居点视为非法，但并未禁止在那里种植或制造产品。 现在，英国外交大臣埃德·米利班德宣布英国同意国际法院 2024 年的裁决，即整个占领（包括以色列的军事存在）是非法的，他表示政府的经济关系必须反映这一点。 因此，禁令不仅针对产品，还针对为定居点提供建筑、基础设施或融资的公司。这些措施还包括限制“对占领产生实质性贡献”的武器销售，其力度超出了许多人的预期。 令人震惊的不仅仅是行动，外交大臣发自内心的、有时是深刻的个人声明的语言也如此引人注目。 作为一名“自豪的英国犹太人……坚定不移地支持以色列国”，米利班德的讲话比他的任何前任都更加直接和直率。 英国外交大臣竟然说“定居者恐怖主义猖獗”，并对约旦河西岸部分地区的巴勒斯坦人进行“种族清洗”，而以色列政府却“对此视而不见”，这确实是了不起的。 米利班德称这是英国政策的“重置”。如今，这有时让人感觉像是一次彻底的反思，导致英以关系陷入数十年来的最低谷。 是的，即将到来的以色列选举总是伴随着激烈、狂热的气氛，这可能导致了以色列外交部长吉迪恩……

reflection.en: The diplomatic tensions between Britain and Israel, sparked by a trade ban, have escalated rapidly, leading to a significant strain on their relationship. In times of such heightened conflict and anger, the call to pursue peace, even with those who seem adversarial, remains a vital principle.
reflection.zh: 英以两国之间因贸易禁令引发的外交紧张局势迅速升级，导致两国关系严重紧张。在冲突和愤怒加剧的时刻，即使面对看似敌对的对方，寻求和平的呼吁仍然是一项重要的原则。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Five killed in Miami plane crash were in two vehicles on ground, investigators say
title.zh: 迈阿密飞机坠毁事故致五人死亡，调查人员称其在地面两辆车内

summary.en: Investigators described the scene as "utter devastation" after a Boeing 767-300 overshot the runway at Miami airport, killing five people who were in two vehicles on the ground.
summary.zh: 调查人员称，一架波音767-300飞机在迈阿密机场冲出跑道后，现场“一片狼藉”，造成地面两辆车内的五人死亡。

body.en:
The five people killed and five injured when an Amazon cargo plane crashed on landing at Miami International Airport were in two vehicles on the ground, investigators said.

The Boeing 767-300, operated by 21 Air, overshot the runway on Sunday and hit an airline cleaning van holding seven people before breaking the perimeter fence and striking a Toyota SUV with three inside.

Jennifer Homendy, chairwoman of the National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB), called the crash scene "utter devastation" and said it was too early to identify a cause.

Investigators have recovered the flight recorders and will look at flight systems, crew experience and weather as potential factors, say aviation experts.

Miami authorities on Tuesday identified the five people who died as Rolando Aleman Leon, 55; Yoel Rodriguez Naranjo, 53; Julio C Pineda, 75; Carlos Acosta Fajardo, 53; and Javierkys Reyes Quevedo, 47.

Three people remain in hospital, including two in critical condition. The pilot and co-pilot, who were also injured, have since been released from hospital, officials said, according to the Miami Herald , external .

"It's an incredibly tragic incident that has occurred," the Miami-Dade County Sheriff Rosie Cordero-Stutz told reporters on Tuesday. "One leaves their house to go to work, to visit family, to do what we normally do, without thinking that is even a possibility."

Lawyers representing the widow of one of the victims said in a statement that they would pursue justice for those "impacted by what we believe was an entirely preventable tragedy".

"No one should lose their loved one this way, and we will pursue every possible avenue of justice for this family," said lawyers John Morgan and Jorge Garcia.

Earlier, speaking at a press conference at Miami International Airport on Monday, the NTSB's Homendy said the aircraft had two crew members on board and was arriving from San Juan, Puerto Rico, on its third flight of the day.

The plane struck navigational aids and equipment after overrunning the runway, before hitting a white Ford van owned by a contract cleaning company.

It then travelled through a perimeter fence and collided with a Toyota Corolla, coming to rest about 1,300ft (394m) beyond the runway.

Debris from the aircraft, mangled vehicles and airport fencing was left strewn across the area.

"It's hard to see, and I'm sure very difficult for the first responders as well," said Homendy during the press conference.

She said recovering victims' bodies was the current priority, adding: "The investigation and access to the aircraft, as well as evidence, can wait."

The flight data recorder and cockpit voice recorder have been recovered and are being sent to NTSB headquarters for evaluation.

Homendy said investigators could not yet say anything...
body.zh: 调查人员称，一架亚马逊货机在迈阿密国际机场降落时坠毁，地面上的两辆车造成五人死亡、五人受伤。 这架由 21 Air 运营的波音 767-300 飞机周日冲出跑道，撞上了一辆载有 7 人的航空公司清洁车，然后冲破了围栏，撞上了一辆载有 3 人的丰田 SUV。 美国国家运输安全委员会 (NTSB) 主席詹妮弗·霍曼迪 (Jennifer Homendy) 称坠机现场“彻底毁灭”，并表示现在确定事故原因还为时过早。 航空专家表示，调查人员已经找到了飞行记录仪，并将研究飞行系统、机组人员经验和天气等潜在因素。 迈阿密当局周二确认五名死者为罗兰多·阿莱曼·莱昂 (Rolando Aleman Leon)，55 岁；尤尔·罗德里格斯·纳兰霍，53 岁；胡里奥·C·皮内达，75 岁；卡洛斯·阿科斯塔·法哈多，53 岁；和哈维尔基斯·雷耶斯·克维多，47 岁。 三人仍在医院，其中两人情况危急。据《迈阿密先驱报》外部报道，官员称，同样受伤的飞行员和副驾驶现已出院。 迈阿密戴德县警长罗西·科德罗-斯图茨周二对记者表示：“这是一起令人难以置信的悲惨事件。” “人们离开家去工作、探望家人、做我们通常做的事情，甚至不认为这是可能的。” 一名受害者遗孀的代理律师在一份声明中表示，他们将为那些“受到我们认为完全可以避免的悲剧影响的人”伸张正义。 律师约翰·摩根和豪尔赫·加西亚表示：“任何人都不应该以这种方式失去亲人，我们将为这个家庭寻求一切可能的正义途径。” 早些时候，国家运输安全委员会的霍曼迪周一在迈阿密国际机场举行的新闻发布会上表示，这架飞机上有两名机组人员，是从波多黎各圣胡安抵达的，这是当天的第三次航班。 飞机冲出跑道后撞上了导航设备和设备，然后撞上了一家合同清洁公司拥有的一辆白色福特面包车。 然后它穿过围栏并与一辆丰田卡罗拉相撞，在跑道外约 1,300 英尺（394m）处停下。 飞机残骸、受损车辆和机场围栏散落在整个地区。 霍曼迪在新闻发布会上说：“这很难看到，而且我确信对于急救人员来说也很困难。” 她表示，目前的首要任务是打捞遇难者尸体，并补充道：“调查、飞机接触以及证据可以等待。” 飞行数据记录器和驾驶舱语音记录器已被找到，并正在送往 NTSB 总部进行评估。 霍曼迪表示，调查人员目前还不能透露任何信息……

reflection.en: The news of the plane crash at Miami International Airport paints a grim picture of 'utter devastation.' Five lives were tragically cut short, not in the air, but on the ground, caught in the wreckage. In moments like these, our hearts ache for the finality of death and the grief it brings. Yet, Scripture offers a profound hope: a future where Yahweh...
reflection.zh: 迈阿密国际机场的飞机坠毁事故新闻描绘了一幅“一片狼藉”的严峻景象。五条生命不幸陨落，并非在空中，而是在地面上，被卷入了残骸之中。在这样的时刻，我们为死亡的终结及其带来的悲伤而心痛。然而，圣经提供了一个深刻的盼望：雅伟自己将擦去一切眼泪，死亡、哀恸和痛苦将不再存在（启示录 21:4）。

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

title.en: California hails rare sighting of gray wolf in Mendocino national forest
title.zh: 加州国家森林罕见发现灰狼踪迹

summary.en: California wildlife officials have confirmed the presence of a gray wolf in the Mendocino National Forest, marking the first sighting in the state since the species was reintroduced in 2011. This rare occurrence suggests the species, previously driven to extinction in California, is expanding its range.
summary.zh: 加州野生动物官员证实，加州门多西诺国家森林中出现了一只灰狼的踪迹。这是自该物种于2011年被重新引入加州以来首次在该州被发现。这一罕见事件表明，该物种——此前在加州已灭绝——正在扩大其活动范围。

body.en: Officials say sighting a sign species – driven to extinction in state before reintroduction in 2011 – expanding its range A gray wolf has recently been seen in California’s Mendocino national forest for the first time since the species returned to the state 15 years ago, state wildlife officials confirmed. Officials in Lake county, which is about two hours north of San Francisco, said last week the California department of fish and wildlife (CDFW) had received reports of sightings in the forest in late August. The agency verified the presence of a wolf in the far north end of the county, county supervisor Brad Rasmussen said in a statement on social media. Continue reading...
body.zh: 官员们表示，看到了一种在该州濒临灭绝的标志性物种，该物种于 2011 年重新引入，其活动范围不断扩大。州野生动物官员证实，最近在加利福尼亚州门多西诺国家森林中发现了一只灰狼，这是自该物种 15 年前重返该州以来的首次。距离旧金山以北约两小时车程的莱克县官员上周表示，加州鱼类和野生动物部门 (CDFW) 收到了八月底在森林中出现目击事件的报告。县主管布拉德·拉斯穆森在社交媒体上的一份声明中表示，该机构证实该县最北端存在狼。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The return of the gray wolf to California's Mendocino National Forest is a hopeful sign. After being driven to extinction, its reappearance suggests a healing in the ecosystem. It reminds us of the goodness of creation, which Yahweh declared 'very good' at its beginning, and the potential for renewal even after devastation.
reflection.zh: 灰狼重返加州门多西诺国家森林是一个充满希望的迹象。在曾一度灭绝后，它的重新出现表明生态系统正在得到修复。这让我们想起雅伟在创世之初所宣告的“甚好”的受造之物的美好，以及即使在荒凉之后也可能存在的更新的潜力。

verse.textEn: God saw all that he had made, and it was very good.
verse.textZh: 神看着一切所造的都甚好。

title.en: Saudi oil sites hit as Houthi attacks intensify amid US-Iran Fighting
title.zh: 沙特石油设施遭袭，胡塞武装袭击加剧，美伊冲突升级

summary.en: Yemen's Iranian-backed Houthi rebels attacked four cities in southern Saudi Arabia, injuring over 70 people and setting oil facilities ablaze. Simultaneously, explosions were reported at Iran's major oil hub and in the Gulf of Oman, suggesting a potential resumption of US strikes.
summary.zh: 也门受伊朗支持的胡塞武装周二袭击了沙特阿拉伯南部四个城市，造成70多人受伤，并点燃了石油设施。与此同时，据伊朗媒体报道，伊朗主要石油枢纽哈尔格岛以及阿曼湾的杰斯克港也发生爆炸，表明美国可能在美国与伊朗的冲突暂停两天后恢复了打击行动。

body.en:
Yemen’s Iranian-backed Houthi rebels attacked four cities in southern Saudi Arabia, a US ally, on Tuesday, injuring more than 70 people and setting oil facilities ablaze in what appeared to be a significant escalation of the six-month-old conflict in the Middle East.

At the same time, explosions were reported on Kharg Island, Iran’s major oil hub, and in the Gulf of Oman port of Jask, according to Iranian media, suggesting that US strikes against Iran may have resumed following a two-day pause.

Iranian news agency Tasnim reported that a US missile hit an Iranian tanker approximately 6 kilometres from Kharg Island. The vessel’s crew was reportedly being evacuated, although no casualties were reported, citing local sources.

The Pentagon did not immediately comment on the reports. However, a Fox News reporter, citing unidentified senior US officials, said the strikes were carried out by the US military.

In Saudi Arabia, the Houthis, who control most of Yemen's populated areas including the capital, said they had launched a broad operation deep into Saudi territory.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

They used drones and missiles to strike a Saudi airbase in the southern city of Khamis Mushait as well as Saudi state oil company assets in the cities of Abha, Najran and Jazan.

NASA satellite images showed a thick cloud of black smoke over the Jazan refinery and a column of white smoke rising from an oil distribution centre in Abha.

Saudi authorities described blazes at the sites and said women and children were among the 73 people hurt.

The reports of such large numbers of wounded suggested the attacks were among the biggest carried out against Saudi Arabia since the US and Israel launched their war against Iran in February.

No confirmed images from the ground of the attacked Saudi cities were available, and witnesses could not be reached in a country where media is tightly controlled.

After a month of calm in August, fighting in the Gulf has resumed, with Iran and the U.S. exchanging fire, sending global oil prices back towards the US$100 ($138.5) a barrel level passed at the war's peak.

Prices for benchmark Brent crude LCOc1 and US West Texas Intermediate CLc1 rose and were on track for their highest closes since July 23.

Houthi attacks on southwestern Saudi Arabia have the potential to worsen the war's global economic impact by disrupting Middle East energy supplies beyond the blockaded Strait of Hormuz.

Saudi Arabia has led an Arab coalition battling against the Houthis in Yemen for more than a decade. That war had calmed in recent years, but a ceasefire there has broken down, with the Houthis threatening shipping at...
body.zh: 周二，伊朗支持的也门胡塞叛军袭击了美国盟友沙特阿拉伯南部的四个城市，造成 70 多人受伤，并点燃了石油设施，这似乎是中东六个月冲突的重大升级。 与此同时，据伊朗媒体报道，伊朗主要石油枢纽哈格岛和阿曼湾贾斯克港发生爆炸，这表明美国对伊朗的打击可能在暂停两天后恢复。 伊朗塔斯尼姆通讯社报道称，一枚美国导弹击中了距离哈格岛约6公里处的一艘伊朗油轮。据当地消息人士称，该船的船员正在撤离，但没有人员伤亡的报道。 五角大楼没有立即对这些报道发表评论。不过，福克斯新闻记者援引未透露姓名的美国高级官员的话称，此次袭击是由美军实施的。 在沙特阿拉伯，控制着也门大部分人口稠密地区（包括首都）的胡塞武装表示，他们已深入沙特领土开展广泛行动。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 他们使用无人机和导弹袭击了南部城市海米斯穆谢特的沙特空军基地以及沙特国家石油公司在艾卜哈、纳季兰和吉赞等城市的资产。 美国宇航局卫星图像显示，吉赞炼油厂上空冒出浓浓的黑烟，艾卜哈的石油配送中心冒出一柱白烟。 沙特当局描述了现场起火情况，并表示 73 名受伤者中有妇女和儿童。 有关如此大量伤员的报道表明，这是自美国和以色列二月份对伊朗发动战争以来针对沙特阿拉伯发动的最大规模的袭击之一。 目前还没有来自受袭击的沙特城市地面的确认图像，在媒体受到严格控制的国家也无法联系到目击者。 经过 8 月份一个月的平静之后，海湾地区的战斗重新开始，伊朗和美国交火，导致全球油价回到战争高峰时每桶 100 美元（138.5 美元）的水平。 基准布伦特原油 LCOc1 和美国西德克萨斯中质原油 CLc1 价格上涨，并有望创下 7 月 23 日以来的最高收盘价。 胡塞武装对沙特阿拉伯西南部的袭击可能会扰乱被封锁的霍尔木兹海峡以外的中东能源供应，从而加剧战争对全球经济的影响。 十多年来，沙特阿拉伯领导阿拉伯联盟与也门胡塞武装作战。近年来，这场战争已经平静下来，但那里的停火已经破裂，胡塞武装威胁在......

reflection.en: The news from the Middle East paints a grim picture of escalating conflict, with attacks on oil facilities and potential retaliatory strikes. This cycle of violence, where each action seems to provoke a harsher response, traps communities in a spiral of destruction. The ancient wisdom reminds us that true strength lies not in mirroring aggression, but in...
reflection.zh: 中东的新闻描绘了一幅冲突升级的严峻图景，石油设施遭到袭击，可能还会有报复性打击。这种暴力循环，每一次行动似乎都在引发更严厉的回应，将社区困在毁灭的漩涡中。古老的智慧提醒我们，真正的力量不在于以暴制暴，而在于积极选择和平的道路，拒绝被邪恶压倒。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: LIV files for bankruptcy protection with $45m owed to players
title.zh: LIV申请破产保护，欠球员4500万美元

summary.en: LIV Golf has filed for bankruptcy protection in the United States, owing at least $45 million to players, as it seeks new investment following the withdrawal of Saudi Arabian funding. The league still plans to launch its new season next year.
summary.zh: 在沙特阿拉伯撤资后，LIV Golf已在美国申请破产保护，欠款至少4500万美元，并正在寻求新的投资。该联盟仍计划于明年启动新赛季。

body.en:
LIV Golf has filed for bankruptcy protection with at least $45m (£33m) owed to players, who will now have the option to leave.

A Chapter 11 petition, which LIV says is to "preserve the company's business" as it attempts to restructure after Saudi Arabia withdrew its multibillion-dollar funding, was filed in the United States on Tuesday.

The breakaway league says it has found a new investor in BC Partners, following the decision in April by Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund (PIF) to pull its funding.

Documents in the petition outline money owed to LIV Golf's creditors with the 30 largest unsecured claims. Two-time major winner Jon Rahm tops that list with an unsecured claim of $7.5m (£5.5m).

Bryson DeChambeau ($5.7m - £4.2m), Dustin Johnson ($5.5m - £4.1m), Cameron Smith ($4.8m - £3.5m) and Tyrrell Hatton ($3.4m - £2.5m) are also among the top 30 creditors, as well as Brooks Koepka, who left to rejoin the PGA Tour in January but has an unsecured claim of $1.7m (£1.25m).

The total amount owed to the 14 current and former LIV players in the top 30 creditors is just over $45m (£33m).

The court documents show LIV estimates its assets at $100m-$500m (£74m-£370m) and its liabilities at between $500m and $1bn (£370m-£739m).

LIV Golf intends to commence its new majority player-owned league early next year and it is understood the Chapter 11 process allows it to start talking to players about their participation in LIV's future.

BBC Sport understands there is no obligation on players to sign on to LIV 2.0, regardless of whether they had previously signed multi-year contracts with LIV Golf.

Sources have said contracts under the previous iteration of LIV Golf will finish because of this court filing, with amounts owed to players and other creditors addressed through the court process.

However, it remains unclear when players would then be able to enter discussions with other tours.

Since LIV's controversial launch in 2021, more than $5bn (£3.7bn) has been spent by PIF, with major winners including Rahm and DeChambeau lured by lucrative contracts and vast prize money.

However, the future of the concept - and its star players - has been shrouded in uncertainty, with the 2026 season having ended early.

LIV Golf chief executive Scott O'Neil told the BBC at the final event in Indianapolis last month he had "high levels of confidence" in achieving a "critical mass" of players to make the new league a reality.

DeChambeau said at the conclusion of that event he felt there was "a lot of potential moving forward" and he believed there was "something fun coming".

Speaking on Tuesday before this week's Irish Open, Rahm was tight-lipped when pressed on his future.

Asked if he knew what the coming months held, he told BBC Sport: "Yes and no. It hasn't...
body.zh: LIV Golf 已申请破产保护，欠球员至少 4500 万美元（3300 万英镑），球员现在可以选择离开。 周二，LIV 在美国提交了一份《美国破产法》第 11 章请愿书，称其目的是“保护公司业务”，因为该公司在沙特阿拉伯撤回数十亿美元资金后试图进行重组。 该脱离联盟表示，继沙特阿拉伯公共投资基金 (PIF) 四月份决定撤回其资金后，它已找到 BC Partners 的新投资者。 请愿书中的文件概述了 LIV Golf 债权人的欠款，其中包括 30 项最大的无担保债权。两届大满贯冠军乔恩·拉姆 (Jon Rahm) 以 750 万美元（550 万英镑）的无担保索赔名列榜首。 布赖森·德尚博（Bryson DeChambeau）（570万美元 - 420万英镑）、达斯汀·约翰逊（Dustin Johnson）（550万美元 - 410万英镑）、卡梅隆·史密斯（Cameron Smith）（480万美元 - 350万英镑）和泰瑞尔·哈顿（Tyrrell Hatton）（340万美元 - 250万英镑）也在前30名债权人之列，还有布鲁克斯·科普卡（Brooks Koepka），他在一月份离开重新加入美巡赛，但拥有无担保索赔170 万美元（125 万英镑）。 前 30 名债权人中 14 名现任和前任 LIV 球员的欠款总额刚刚超过 4500 万美元（3300 万英镑）。 法庭文件显示，LIV 估计其资产为 1 亿至 5 亿美元（7400 万至 3.7 亿英镑），负债在 5 亿至 10 亿美元（3.7 亿至 7.39 亿英镑）之间。 LIV Golf 打算在明年初开始其新的多数球员拥有的联赛，据了解，第 11 章流程允许其开始与球员讨论他们对 LIV 未来的参与。 BBC 体育了解到，球员没有义务签约 LIV 2.0，无论他们之前是否与 LIV Golf 签署了多年合同。 消息人士称，LIV Golf 上一版本的合同将因这份法庭文件而结束，欠球员和其他债权人的金额将通过法庭程序得到解决。 然而，目前还不清楚球员何时能够与其他巡回赛进行讨论。 自 2021 年 LIV 备受争议的推出以来，PIF 已花费超过 50 亿美元（37 亿英镑），包括拉姆和德尚博在内的主要赢家被利润丰厚的合同和巨额奖金所吸引。 然而，随着 2026 赛季提前结束，这一概念及其明星球员的未来一直笼罩在不确定之中。 LIV Golf 首席执行官斯科特·奥尼尔 (Scott O'Neil) 上个月在印第安纳波利斯举行的决赛中告诉 BBC，他对达到“临界数量”的球员以使新联盟成为现实抱有“高度信心”。 德尚博在那次活动结束时表示，他觉得“前进的潜力很大”，并且相信“会有一些有趣的事情即将到来”。 周二，在本周的爱尔兰公开赛之前，拉姆在被问及自己的未来时守口如瓶。 当被问及是否知道未来几个月会发生什么时，他告诉英国广播公司体育频道：“是的，也不是。还没有……

reflection.en: The financial instability of LIV Golf, marked by its bankruptcy filing and the withdrawal of significant funding, underscores the precariousness of ventures built on shifting allegiances rather than enduring principles. Proverbs 16:12 reminds us that establishing justice and integrity is a foundation for lasting stability, a principle that seems absent in...
reflection.zh: LIV Golf因资金撤出而申请破产保护，显示出建立在不稳固关系而非持久原则上的事业的脆弱性。箴言16:12提醒我们，建立公义和正直是持久稳定的基础，而这一原则似乎在这种高风险的体育事业中有所缺失。

verse.textEn: Kings detest wrongdoing, for a throne is established through righteousness.
verse.textZh: 作恶为王所憎恶，因国位是靠公义坚立。

title.en: Former lab analyst sentenced to 10 years in prison for manipulating DNA data
title.zh: 因操纵DNA数据，前实验室分析师被判处10年监禁

summary.en: Authorities accused Missy Woods of altering years worth of data in cases involving homicide, sexual assault and robbery. A judge sentenced a former forensic analyst for the Colorado Bureau of Investigation to 10 years in prison on Tuesday after authorities said her manipulation of DNA data had raised questions about...
summary.zh: 当局指控米西·伍兹篡改了涉及凶杀、性侵和抢劫案件的多年数据。周二，一名科罗拉多州调查局前法医分析师被判处10年监禁，此前当局表示她操纵DNA数据引发了对数百起刑事案件有效性的质疑。

body.en: Authorities accused Missy Woods of altering years worth of data in cases involving homicide, sexual assault and robbery A judge sentenced a former forensic analyst for the Colorado Bureau of Investigation to 10 years in prison on Tuesday after authorities said her manipulation of DNA data had raised questions about the validity of hundreds of criminal cases. Yvonne “Missy” Woods pleaded guilty in June to perjury, attempting to influence a public servant, forgery and committing a cybercrime. Dozens of other counts were dismissed as part of a plea agreement. Continue reading...
body.zh: 当局指控米西·伍兹 (Missy Woods) 在涉及凶杀、性侵犯和抢劫的案件中篡改了数年的数据。周二，一名法官判处科罗拉多州调查局前法医分析师 10 年监禁，此前当局表示，她对 DNA 数据的篡改引发了对数百起刑事案件有效性的质疑。伊冯·“小姐”·伍兹 (Yvonne “Missy” Woods) 于 6 月承认作伪证、试图影响公务员、伪造文件和网络犯罪。作为认罪协议的一部分，其他数十项罪名被驳回。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The integrity of evidence is paramount in the pursuit of justice. When that integrity is compromised, as in the case of Missy Woods manipulating DNA data, the very foundations of legal accountability are shaken. This breach erodes trust and leaves many cases in doubt, a painful reminder of how systemic failures can leave victims and the accused in limbo.
reflection.zh: 证据的完整性在追求正义的过程中至关重要。当这种完整性受到损害时，正如米西·伍兹篡改DNA数据一案所示，法律问责制的根基动摇了。这种破坏侵蚀了信任，使许多案件变得可疑，令人痛苦地提醒我们，系统性的失败可能让受害者和被告陷入困境。

verse.textEn: The law is paralyzed, and justice never prevails. The wicked hem in the righteous, so that justice is perverted.
verse.textZh: 因此律法放松，公理也不显明；恶人围困义人，所以公理显然颠倒。

title.en: 'Absolute nightmare': Mass flight cancellations in the UK prompt calls for dismissals
title.zh: “简直是噩梦”：英国大规模航班取消引发解雇呼声

summary.en: Nearly 1,100 flights to and from UK airports were cancelled overnight due to a 'system issue'.
summary.zh: 由于“系统问题”，英国机场往返的近1100个航班在夜间被取消。

body.en:
Consumer chaos has descended on the UK's busiest airports as an air traffic glitch causes major disruptions, prompting calls to fire the head of the air traffic control service.

Almost 1,100 flights to and from UK airports were cancelled Tuesday, due to what the country's air traffic control service called a technical issue, in this latest error.

A total of 1,055 flights to and from British airports had been axed by 8 pm (5 am AEST) according to the aircraft tracking website FlightRadar24.

"Recovery from today's system issue has taken longer than we had hoped," Britain's air traffic control service, known as NATS, said on social media.

"Our system issue is now resolved, we are operating normally and working as hard as possible to clear the backlog of flights," it noted, adding "this is hugely frustrating and apologise unreservedly".

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Tuesday's issues follow a technical glitch in July last year that saw scores of flights to and from the UK cancelled and which prompted anger from airline chiefs.

Britain saw its worst air systems failure in years in 2023, with more than 700,000 passengers affected after hundreds of flights were delayed or cancelled.

Heathrow Airport, Britain's largest and busiest airport, in west London, confirmed it was among those affected on Tuesday, along with Gatwick to the south of the UK capital.

"It's just an absolute nightmare down there," healthcare worker Josie Donoghue said of Gatwick after leaving the airport, having had to disembark her flight to Ireland after three hours stuck on the runway.

"Getting through that airport was like trying to get out of Alcatraz," she told Britain's domestic Press Association news agency.

Liverpool, Birmingham and Edinburgh airports were also affected, while Dublin Airport in Ireland said it had cancelled dozens of flights.

British Airways said it had to cancel or divert more than 100 flights, affecting tens of thousands of its customers.

Irish no-frills carrier Ryanair said more than 65,000 passengers had been disrupted and it had cancelled more than 50 flights.

Arsenal, due to play Napoli in the Champions League Wednesday in the southern Italian city, were forced to cancel a press conference ahead of the match after the team's flight was delayed.

British Transport Secretary Heidi Alexander said on X she was "seeking assurances that lessons will be learned and systems that support aviation are up to the job".

But Ryanair COO Neal McMahon repeated his calls for NATS chief executive Martin Rolfe to be fired, accusing him of having again "failed UK travellers".

"Enough is enough, it's time for the UK government to intervene... and put somebody...

body.en:
Israel ‌says it's closing Britain's consulate in East Jerusalem after plans by the UK, France and Canada to block imports from Israeli settlements in the West Bank.

Britain will also no longer participate in a US-led coordination mission ‌for Gaza and some British officials, including former Labour party leader Jeremy Corbyn, and other nationals will be banned from entering Israel, Israeli Foreign Minister Gideon Saar said.

"The British move is morally distorted, and constitutes blatant interference in the affairs of a sovereign ‌state and its electoral process," he said, describing comments by Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband about ethnic cleansing of Palestinians by Israel as accusations that were "outrageous lies".

The British consulate in East Jerusalem is accredited to the Palestinian Authority in the West Bank.

Saar said that he had coordinated Israel's response with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu as Israeli President Isaac Herzog accused Britain of interfering in Israel's upcoming elections, due in late October.

They were joined by the foreign ministers of 10 other countries, including Denmark, Norway, Poland, Spain and Sweden, in a statement reaffirming ‌support for a negotiated two-state settlement — ‌a Palestinian state co-existing peacefully alongside Israel. ⁠Concern is mounting over settlement expansion and violence in the Israeli-occupied West Bank.

"Together, we are resolute: the two-state solution must be protected, and we will take action in pursuit of a just and lasting peace," they said.

Australia is unlikely to join the ban on imports, with Foreign Minister Penny Wong previously ruling it out.

Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said Australia's position on the Middle East remains the same.

"I have made clear on a number of occasions — we support a two-state solution in the Middle East. We think that is important for both Israelis and Palestinians to be able to live in peace and security," he said.

Miliband said on Tuesday that Britain could no longer simply "call out" injustice and suffering, but had to act to oppose the expansion of settlements, which he said threatened the viability of a Palestinian state.

title.en: UK announces sanctions on West Bank settlements prompting furious Israeli response
title.zh: 英国宣布对约旦河西岸定居点实施制裁，引发以色列愤怒回应

summary.en: Britain has imposed sanctions on Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank, with the UK's foreign secretary accusing settlers of "ethnic cleansing" of Palestinians. Israel's foreign minister responded by calling the accusation an "outrageous lie" and announced the closure of the UK's consulate in East Jerusalem.
summary.zh: 英国已对约旦河西岸的以色列定居点实施制裁，英国外交大臣指责定居者对巴勒斯坦人进行“种族清洗”。以色列外交部长回应称这一指控是“骇人听闻的谎言”，并宣布关闭英国驻东耶路撒冷领事馆。

body.en:
The UK has announced sanctions on illegal Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank, accusing Israel's government of turning a blind eye to the "ethnic cleansing" of Palestinians by settlers.

Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband said the move marked the "beginning of a new approach" to the Israeli-Palestinian conflict, which "not only calls out injustice and suffering but acts".

Israel's Foreign Minister Gideon Saar responded by accusing him of spreading an "outrageous lie" and announced counter-measures including shutting the UK's consulate in East Jerusalem.

The UK sanctions will ban settlement goods but also act against companies and individuals providing services for settlement expansion.

The sanctions were launched alongside France and Canada, which in a joint statement with the UK said the action "marks a further turning point in our approach to protecting the two-state solution".

Settlements are illegal under international law, and there has been a rise in violence towards Palestinians in the West Bank by settlers in recent months.

In a statement to MPs, Miliband said: "The British government agrees that there is ethnic cleansing of Palestinians in areas of the West Bank, perpetrated by settler terrorists.

"And all too often the Israeli government has turned a blind eye to this and worse, members of it have made statements and taken actions to support the forced displacement of Palestinians."

He said ethnic cleansing was defined by the UN as a "purposeful policy designed by one ethnic or religious group to remove by violent means another ethnic or religious group from certain areas".

Miliband said the official view of the government was that the Israeli occupation of the West Bank was unlawful because of the "entrenchment of its control, its intention to extend permanent sovereignty, and its expansionist agenda via illegal settlements".

He said this position, which is in line with a 2024 advisory opinion from the International Court of Justice, should be reflected in the UK's "economic relationship" with the occupied West Bank.

As a result, over the next six to nine months, the UK will introduce "a new comprehensive sanctions regime", he said.

The foreign secretary also announced a ban on advertising illegal West Bank settlements in the UK.

"The sanctions regime will target illegal settlements and settlement expansion, not Israel," Miliband added.

Later on Tuesday, Prime Minister Andy Burnham said the targeted measures were "aimed not at the Israeli people, but in support of the two-state solution".

This action, and Israel's sharp retort, underscores the difficulty of navigating justice and human rights in international relations. title.en: German economy frets about Saxony-Anhalt election results
title.zh: 德国经济因萨克森-安哈尔特州选举结果而担忧

summary.en: The AfD won the election in the eastern German state of Saxony-Anhalt by a wide margin. While politicians and analysts debate the reasons for the far-right party's popularity, economists are sounding the alarm about the potential implications of this significant political shift.
summary.zh: 在德国东部萨克森-安哈尔特州的选举中，德国选择党（AfD）以较大优势获胜。尽管政治家和分析人士仍在辩论该极右翼政党受欢迎的原因，但经济学家们已对这一重大政治转变的潜在影响敲响了警钟。

body.en:
The AfD won the election in the eastern German state by a wide margin. While politicians and election analysts are still debating the reasons for the far-right party's popularity, economists are sounding the alarm.

The results came in as predicted: The AfD, which is considered far-right extremist in parts, won the election in Saxony-Anhalt and could now put forward the state’s minister-president and take over the  state government . 

What hardly anyone expected, however, was this: The governing CDU is now barely half as strong as it was, while the other parties have been left far behind. Calling it a landslide victory for the AfD is no exaggeration. And many commentators go so far as to call it a turning point in Germany’s postwar history.

"A state government led by the AfD would certainly be seen by many as a turning point and would further fuel the debate over how best to deal with the party," Commerzbank economist Ralph Solveen told Reuters.

At the same time, he advises waiting to see what happens, saying that things are rarely as bad as they seem.

"Many of these decisions are unlikely to affect the economy until the medium to long term," he said. "Decisions on most taxes, the structure of the labor market and social security systems are made at the federal level. That is why the AfD, in many of its pledges, only promises to advocate for something in the Bundesrat, which is unlikely to succeed given the foreseeable isolation of an AfD-led government."

Many business community concerns had already been raised before the election. It also became clear that there are differing views within the AfD, which could lead to unpredictable policies.

For example, DW reported two months ago that Hannes Loth, a member of the AfD and the mayor in Raguhn-Jessnitz, Saxony-Anhalt, sought to have six new wind turbines installed. This pledge puts him at odds with the official stance of his own party.

Whether this is a sign of internal party pluralism or simply local political pragmatism will become clear during the coming legislative term, especially if the AfD ends up in the state government. It is not, however, serving to reassure business leaders.

One issue the AfD campaigned on was a promise to limit the number of foreigners. But will the party actually be able to implement its goal? On this point, Michael Berlemann, director of the Hamburg Institute of International Economics (HWWI), remains skeptical.

"A large part of the measures it has promised cannot be implemented at the state level because the federal government is responsible for them," he said. "Another part would be illegal and would be overturned by the courts after some delay: The AfD cannot...
body.zh: 德国选择党以大幅优势赢得了德国东部各州的选举。尽管政治家和选举分析人士仍在争论极右翼政党受欢迎的原因，但经济学家已经敲响了警钟。 结果正如预期的那样：被部分视为极右极端主义的德国选择党赢得了萨克森-安哈特州的选举，现在可以推举该州部长兼总统并接管州政府。 然而，几乎没有人预料到的是：执政的基民盟现在的实力只有原来的一半，而其他政党则被远远抛在了后面。称其为德国选择党的压倒性胜利并不夸张。许多评论家甚至称其为德国战后历史的转折点。 德国商业银行经济学家拉尔夫·索尔文对路透社表示：“由德国选择党领导的州政府肯定会被许多人视为一个转折点，并将进一步加剧有关如何最好地与该党打交道的争论。” 与此同时，他建议静观其变，并表示事情很少像看上去那么糟糕。 “其中许多决定在中长期之前不太可能影响经济，”他说。 “大多数税收、劳动力市场结构和社会保障体系的决定都是在联邦层面做出的。这就是为什么选择党在其许多承诺中只承诺在联邦参议院倡导某些东西，鉴于选择党领导的政府可预见的孤立，这一点不太可能成功。” 许多商界的担忧在选举前就已经提出。很明显，德国选择党内部存在不同观点，这可能导致政策不可预测。 例如，德国之声两个月前报道称，德国选择党成员兼萨克森-安哈尔特州拉古恩-杰斯尼茨市市长汉内斯·洛斯(Hannes Loth)寻求安装六台新风力涡轮机。这一承诺使他与本党的官方立场不一致。 这究竟是党内多元化的标志，还是仅仅是地方政治实用主义的标志，将在即将到来的立法任期内变得清晰，特别是如果选择党最终入主州政府的话。然而，这并不能让企业领导人放心。 德国选择党竞选的议题之一是承诺限制外国人数量。但该党真的能够实现其目标吗？对于这一点，汉堡国际经济研究所 (HWWI) 所长迈克尔·伯勒曼 (Michael Berlemann) 仍持怀疑态度。 他说：“它所承诺的大部分措施无法在州一级实施，因为联邦政府要对它们负责。” “另一部分将是非法的，并会在拖延一段时间后被法院推翻：选择党不能……

Such dramatic political upheavals can create uncertainty and anxiety, particularly for economic stability. title.en: New Yorkers were 'lied' to about toxic air after 9/11 attacks, says Mamdani
title.zh: 马姆达尼称，9/11袭击后纽约人被告知的空气有毒情况是谎言

summary.en: Newly released documents reveal that officials downplayed health risks and assured the public it was safe to breathe Manhattan air shortly after the 9/11 attacks, despite evidence of lingering toxins like asbestos.
summary.zh: 新发布的证据显示，在9/11袭击后不久，尽管有证据表明石棉等有毒物质长期存在，但官员们却淡化了健康风险，并向公众保证曼哈顿的空气可以安全呼吸。

body.en:
Toxic air quality was being recorded in Manhattan soon after the 9/11 attacks even as officials played down health risks to the public, according to a trove of newly released files.

Asbestos was found "nearly everywhere" tested near Ground Zero, where the World Trade Center towers collapsed in 2001, New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani said.

"People got sick because the leaders they trusted lied and told them they were safe to breathe in toxic air," he said, announcing the release of 170,000 documents related to the attacks.

Illnesses related to the dust and smoke from the towers' collapse have claimed more lives than the nearly 3,000 who died in the attacks, US health officials say.

Thousands of people have experienced health effects like cancer, including many who have died, after breathing in hazardous contaminants after the Twin Towers collapsed.

Speaking alongside Mamdani at Tuesday's news conference, TV host and 9/11 survivor advocate Jon Stewart said the new files show the city knew by October 2001 - a month after the terrorist attacks - that the air in Manhattan was toxic.

"So to be fair to them, they only buried that information for 25 years," he said sarcastically.

The records show asbestos was found near Ground Zero for months after the attacks at the same time people were being advised it was safe to go there.

The files, which include air-quality reports and communications among city officials, include October 2001 correspondence known as the "Harding Memo".

In it, an aide warned former Deputy Mayor Robert Harding that the city could face as many as 35,000 legal claims for its response to the attacks.

The document states that the city could be sued because health advisories caused individuals "to return to the area too soon (causing toxic exposure or emotional harm)".

City officials also told citizens to clean up dust and debris with "wet mops and rags" despite the presence of asbestos, which is only supposed to be cleaned by licensed professionals, according to another memo documenting the concerns of congressman Jerry Nadler.

The memo pointed to testimony from the city's top health official at the time saying a study had found "no elevated levels of asbestos in indoor air", but that tests showed dust had "low levels of asbestos in some samples".

The memo, attributed to Ester Fuchs, a special adviser at the time to Mayor Michael Bloomberg, acknowledged "potential problems for City Hall".

Days after the attack, city and federal officials - including the US Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) - declared that the air near the Twin Towers was safe.

Christine Todd Whitman, the head of the EPA at the time, later apologised for this declaration, saying the agency "did the very best we could at the time with the knowledge we...
body.zh: 根据最新公布的大量文件，9/11 袭击事件发生后不久，尽管官员们淡化了公众的健康风险，但曼哈顿的空气质量仍出现了有毒的情况。 纽约市市长佐兰·马姆达尼 (Zohran Mamdani) 表示，在 2001 年世贸中心双塔倒塌的“归零地”附近进行测试时，“几乎到处”都发现了石棉。 他说：“人们之所以生病，是因为他们信任的领导人撒了谎，告诉他们呼吸有毒空气是安全的。”他宣布公布了 17 万份与袭击相关的文件。 美国卫生官员表示，双子塔倒塌产生的灰尘和烟雾导致的疾病导致的死亡人数比在袭击中死亡的近 3,000 人还要多。 双子塔倒塌后，成千上万的人因吸入有害污染物而遭受癌症等健康影响，其中许多人死亡。 在周二的新闻发布会上，电视主持人兼 9/11 幸存者倡导者乔恩·斯图尔特 (Jon Stewart) 与马姆达尼一起发表讲话，他表示，新文件显示，该市在 2001 年 10 月（恐怖袭击发生一个月后）就知道曼哈顿的空气有毒。 “所以公平地说，他们只将这些信息隐藏了 25 年，”他讽刺地说。 记录显示，袭击发生几个月后，在归零地附近发现了石棉，同时人们被告知去那里是安全的。 这些文件包括空气质量报告和市政府官员之间的通信，其中包括 2001 年 10 月的信件，称为“哈丁备忘录”。 一名助手在信中警告前副市长罗伯特·哈丁（Robert Harding），该市可能因其对袭击的反应而面临多达 35,000 项法律索赔。 该文件指出，该市可能会被起诉，因为健康建议导致个人“过早返回该地区（导致有毒物质暴露或情感伤害）”。 另一份记录国会议员杰里·纳德勒担忧的备忘录显示，尽管存在石棉，市政府官员还要求市民用“湿拖把和抹布”清理灰尘和碎片，而石棉只能由有执照的专业人士清洁。 备忘录指出，当时该市最高卫生官员的证词称，一项研究发现“室内空气中的石棉含量没有升高”，但测试显示灰尘“某些样本中的石棉含量较低”。 这份备忘录出自时任迈克尔·布隆伯格市长特别顾问埃斯特·福克斯之手，承认“市政厅存在潜在问题”。 袭击发生几天后，市政府和联邦官员 - 包括美国环境保护署 (EPA) - 宣布双子塔附近的空气是安全的。 时任美国环保署署长克里斯汀·托德·惠特曼后来为这一声明道歉，称该机构“当时已尽了最大努力，因为我们知道……

reflection.en: The release of documents detailing official deception about toxic air after 9/11 is a stark reminder of leadership's responsibility. Jeremiah 22:3 calls rulers to 'execute justice and righteousness,' which fundamentally includes honesty with the people they serve. When leaders mislead, the consequences can be devastating, as seen in the long-term illnesses...
reflection.zh: 9/11事件后关于有毒空气的官方欺骗细节文件公布，是领导责任的严峻提醒。耶利米书22:3呼吁统治者“施行公平和公义”，这根本上包括对他们所服务的人民诚实。当领导者误导时，后果可能是毁灭性的，正如那些暴露在有毒空气中长期患病的人们所见证的。

title.en: Fifty years after Mao’s death, China has transformed. DW looks at why his political legacy still matters.
title.zh: 毛泽东逝世五十周年，中国已发生巨变。德国之声探讨其政治遗产为何仍具影响力。

summary.en: Mao Zedong was perhaps the most influential, and certainly one of the most controversial, figures in 20th-century China. Even five decades after his death, the legacy of his era continues to influence China today.
summary.zh: 毛泽东或许是20世纪中国最具影响力，也无疑是最具争议的人物之一。他去世五十载后，其时代的遗产至今仍在影响着中国。

body.en:
Mao Zedong was perhaps the most influential, and certainly one of the most controversial, figures in 20th-century China. Even five decades after his death, the legacy of his era continues to influence China today.

On September 9, 1976, Mao Zedong died. The revolutionary leader who led the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) to power and founded the People's Republic of China left behind a profoundly contradictory historical legacy.

He shaped the narratives of revolution, nation-building and national independence, but also left behind immense social trauma as a result of successive political campaigns and persecutions.

When Mao died, China was still a poor and relatively isolated communist state. Today, it is the world's second-largest economy, deeply embedded in the supply and value chains of global capitalism, with a vast private sector, a large urban middle class and a highly digitalized society. 

Zhang Lun, a professor at Cergy-Paris University, said Mao left behind four major political legacies: the authoritarian and highly centralized political system; a model of governance that relies on revolution and political campaigns to solve social problems; populist tendencies marked by anti-elitism and anti-rationalism; and utopian visions of egalitarianism and moralism.

From the perspective of political legacies, Zhang told DW, the most fundamental change in China over the past five decades has been "de-Maoization" — while its greatest challenge has been that this process was never fully completed.

Mao's name remains written into the CCP's constitution, while his thought remains part of China's official ideology and his portrait still hangs in Beijing's Tiananmen Square.

Mao helped forge the Chinese Communist Party, and his insistence on the party's supremacy over the state and society has remained a fundamental principle throughout the decades, said Jean Christopher Mittelstaedt, professor at the University of Zurich.

Veteran journalist and political commentator Chang Ping agrees, adding that what has truly endured is the institutional core of the principle that "the party leads everything," serving a state vision of being able to "concentrate resources to accomplish major tasks." 

The CCP, he said, can pursue such objectives "at all costs" — meaning the interests of ordinary people can be sacrificed to the maximum extent necessary to preserve the regime. 

Under current leader Xi Jinping , a number of political concepts and methods of governance associated with the Mao era — such as ideological unity and the spirit of "struggle" — have again attracted attention.

Xi's actions such as abolishing the presidential term limits, strengthening his...
body.zh: 毛泽东也许是 20 世纪中国最有影响力、当然也是最具争议性的人物之一。即使在他去世五年后，他那个时代的遗产仍然影响着今天的中国。 1976年9月9日，毛泽东逝世。 这位领导中国共产党夺取政权、建立中华人民共和国的革命领袖，留下了极其矛盾的历史遗产。 他塑造了革命、国家建设和民族独立的叙事，但也因连续的政治运动和迫害而留下了巨大的社会创伤。 毛泽东去世时，中国仍然是一个贫穷且相对孤立的共产主义国家。如今，它是世界第二大经济体，深深嵌入全球资本主义的供应链和价值链，拥有庞大的私营部门、庞大的城市中产阶级和高度数字化的社会。 巴黎塞尔吉大学教授张伦表示，毛泽东留下了四大政治遗产：专制和高度集权的政治制度；依靠革命和政治运动来解决社会问题的治理模式；以反精英主义和反理性主义为标志的民粹主义倾向；以及平等主义和道德主义的乌托邦愿景。 张向德国之声表示，从政治遗产的角度来看，中国过去50年最根本的变化是“去毛化”，而最大的挑战是这一过程从未完全完成。 毛泽东的名字仍然写进了中国共产党的党章，他的思想仍然是中国官方意识形态的一部分，他的肖像仍然悬挂在北京天安门广场上。 苏黎世大学教授吉恩·克里斯托弗·米特尔施塔特 (Jean Christopher Mittelstaedt) 表示，毛泽东帮助建立了中国共产党，几十年来，他坚持党对国家和社会的至高无上一直是一项基本原则。 资深记者、时事评论员常平对此表示赞同，并补充道，真正经久不衰的是“党领导一切”的制度核心，服务于“集中资源办好大事”的国家愿景。 他说，中共可以“不惜一切代价”追求这些目标——这意味着为了维护政权，可以最大限度地牺牲普通民众的利益。 在现任领导人习近平的领导下，一些与毛泽东时代相关的政治理念和执政方式——例如思想统一和“斗争”精神——再次引起人们的关注。 习近平的行动包括取消国家主席任期限制、加强...

reflection.en: Fifty years after Mao Zedong's death, China has undergone immense transformation. Yet, his legacy, a complex tapestry of nation-building and profound social trauma, continues to shape the nation. This enduring influence reminds us of the weight of leadership, as Proverbs 16:12 states, "Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin is a reproach to any people." The...
reflection.zh: 毛泽东逝世五十载后，中国已发生翻天覆地的变化。然而，他塑造国家、但也留下深重社会创伤的复杂遗产，至今仍在影响着这个国家。这种持久的影响力提醒我们领导者的重担，正如《箴言》16:12所说：“所行的义能使国家安定，不义却能使国家败亡。”领导者的抉择会代代相传，影响着社会的道德和文化根基。

title.en: Ratko Mladic’s funeral casts shadow over Bosnia and Herzegovina vote
title.zh: 拉特科·姆拉迪奇的葬礼给波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那的投票蒙上阴影

summary.en: The funeral of Ratko Mladic in Belgrade, attended by Serbian and Bosnian Serb leaders, has intensified regional tensions and could potentially influence the upcoming election in Bosnia and Herzegovina. Belgrade has stated it did not organize a state funeral for Mladic, who was convicted of genocide and crimes against...
summary.zh: 拉特科·姆拉迪奇在贝尔格莱德的葬礼，塞尔维亚和波斯尼亚塞族领导人出席，加剧了地区紧张局势，并可能影响波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那即将举行的选举。贝尔格莱德方面表示，并未为被判犯有种族灭绝罪和反人类罪的姆拉迪奇举行国葬，但他的遗体由司法部长陪同，并在国家控制的场所举行了带有军事荣誉的仪式，高级政治领导人出席，但没有明确谴责对死者...

body.en:
Ratko Mladic’s funeral in Belgrade, attended by Serbian and Bosnian Serb leaders, has deepened regional tensions and could affect the upcoming election in Bosnia and Herzegovina.

Belgrade has made a point of insisting that it did not organize a state funeral for former Bosnian Serb army commander Ratko Mladic , who was convicted of genocide in Srebrenica and crimes against humanity in 2017.

But when the body of a war criminal is flown home accompanied by the country's justice minister, when ceremonies unfold with military honors in state-controlled venues in the presence of senior political leaders and when clear condemnation of glorification of the deceased is absent, the message is unambiguous.

In Bosnia and Herzegovina — the state created by the 1995 Dayton Peace Agreement, which comprises two entities linked by a weak central government — reactions were as deeply divided as the country itself.

Republika Srpska, the Serb-majority entity covering about 49% of the country's territory, sent its officials to the funeral .

Public discourse there was dominated by narratives of "defending the people" and "the injustice of international courts."

"Without Ratko Mladic , there would be no Republika Srpska," was the refrain among thousands of mourners at the funeral in Belgrade .

Sarajevo , the seat of the central government of Bosnia and Herzegovina, sees this approach as a continued policy of relativizing war crimes and a threat to stability.

In the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina, the entity where Bosniaks and Croats form the majority, the response was very different and the tone sharp.

Foreign Minister Elmedin Konakovic described Serbia's official response as a conscious choice by Belgrade, not something imposed on it.

He announced measures to cool diplomatic ties with Serbia , withdrawing almost all staff from the country's embassy in Belgrade, leaving only the ambassador, explaining that he lacks the authority to close the embassy but can reduce its presence to a minimum. The move effectively froze day-to-day diplomatic communication on the ground.

"We will pull out everyone we can; consular services will be relocated to Zagreb and Podgorica," he said.

Denis Becirovic, chair of the Presidency of Bosnia and Herzegovina, called the funeral with military honors an "anti-civilizational act" and warned of far-reaching consequences for the entire region.

For representatives of Mladic's victims, any public glorification of the former general is a direct insult to the families of those killed.

At a time when both Serbia and Bosnia and Herzegovina are facing general elections — Bosnia on October 4 and Serbia likely just a few weeks later — emotions become a resource.

In both countries, parts of the electorate still see Mladic as a symbol of...
body.zh: 塞尔维亚和波斯尼亚塞族领导人出席了拉特科·姆拉迪奇在贝尔格莱德举行的葬礼，这加剧了地区紧张局势，并可能影响波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那即将举行的选举。 贝尔格莱德坚称没有为前波斯尼亚塞族军队指挥官拉特科·姆拉迪奇举办国葬，他于2017年在斯雷布雷尼察被判犯有种族灭绝罪和危害人类罪。 但当战犯的尸体在该国司法部长的陪同下空运回国时，当在国家控制的场所在高级政治领导人在场的情况下以军事荣誉举行仪式时，当没有明确谴责美化死者时，所传达的信息是明确的。 在波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那——根据 1995 年《代顿和平协议》创建的国家，由两个由薄弱的中央政府联系在一起的实体组成——人们的反应和该国本身一样存在严重分歧。 塞族共和国是一个塞族占多数的实体，覆盖该国约 49% 的领土，派出官员参加了葬礼。 那里的公共话语主要是“保卫人民”和“国际法庭的不公正”的叙述。 “没有拉特科·姆拉迪奇，就不会有塞族共和国”，这是贝尔格莱德葬礼上数千名哀悼者的口号。 波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那中央政府所在地萨拉热窝认为，这一做法是一项持续的政策，使战争罪行相对化，并对稳定构成威胁。 在波斯尼亚人和克罗地亚人占多数的波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那联邦，人们的反应截然不同，语气也很尖锐。 外交部长埃尔梅丁·科纳科维奇表示，塞尔维亚的官方回应是贝尔格莱德有意识的选择，而不是强加的。 他宣布采取措施冷却与塞尔维亚的外交关系，从该国驻贝尔格莱德大使馆撤回几乎所有工作人员，只留下大使，并解释说他无权关闭大使馆，但可以将大使馆的存在减少到最低限度。此举实际上冻结了当地的日常外交沟通。 他说：“我们将撤出我们能撤出的所有人；领事服务将转移到萨格勒布和波德戈里察。” 波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那主席团主席丹尼斯·贝西罗维奇称，以军事荣誉举行的葬礼是“反文明行为”，并警告称这会给整个地区带来深远的后果。 对于姆拉迪奇受害者的代表来说，任何对这位前将军的公开颂扬都是对遇难者家属的直接侮辱。 当塞尔维亚和波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那都面临大选时——波斯尼亚将于 10 月 4 日举行，塞尔维亚可能在几周后举行——情绪成为一种资源。 在这两个国家，部分选民仍然将姆拉迪奇视为......的象征。

reflection.en: The funeral of a convicted war criminal, attended by political leaders, has stirred painful memories and deepened divisions in Bosnia and Herzegovina. In times of such heightened tension, the call to pursue peace, even when faced with actions that seem to glorify past conflict, remains a vital challenge for leaders and citizens alike. May wisdom guide those...
reflection.zh: 一位被定罪的战犯的葬礼，在政治领导人的出席下，在波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那激起了痛苦的回忆并加深了分裂。在如此紧张的局势下，即使面对似乎在颂扬过去冲突的行为，追求和平的呼吁仍然是对领导人和公民 alike 的一项重要挑战。愿智慧引导那些寻求搭建桥梁而非筑墙的人。

title.en: Japan's empty temples seek new ways to survive
title.zh: 日本的空寺庙寻求生存之道

summary.en: Japan's temples are facing significant challenges due to a declining population, shrinking congregations, and economic pressures, leading to the sale or closure of many historic structures. This raises questions about the future of religion in modern Japan.
summary.zh: 由于人口下降、信徒减少和经济压力，日本的寺庙正面临严峻挑战，导致许多历史悠久的寺庙被出售或关闭。这引发了关于现代日本宗教未来的疑问。

body.en:
With a declining population, shrinking congregations and growing economic pressures, temples are struggling to stay relevant. As more temples are sold or closed, is religion in decline in modern Japan?

The 370-year-old structure has all the attributes of a classically designed Japanese temple , from the curved roof to the timber-frame walls, spacious tatami-mat prayer hall and elaborately decorated altar.

Set in manicured gardens on the Chita Peninsula in central Japan , the 350-square-meter (3,767-square-foot) property is on the market for 482 million yen (€2.66 million, US3.01 million). The estate agent's pitch says the price includes dismantling by "expert heritage craftsmen" and delivery to anywhere in Japan, where it would be fully restored into a "stunning" two- or three-bedroom home.

The sale and removal of the temple marks the end of its role in the local community in the hills above the Nagasawacho district, but it is a better fate than many places of worship across Japan.

There are around 77,000 temples across the country, but as many as 17,000 no longer have a full-time resident priest as congregations have shrunk — particularly in rural districts experiencing rapid depopulation — and financial pressures have taken their toll.

That means many temples are being sold off or simply shuttered and left to deteriorate quietly. 

Tomomi Iwayama took on the abandoned Ganshu-ji temple in Odawara, a coastal town about 80 kilometers (50 miles) southwest of Tokyo, a decade ago. Today, he is the abbot of a growing congregation.

"The temple had no abbot for 70 years before I arrived because it was just so difficult to operate, and it has taken me until now to get it financially back on track," he told DW.

"Even in a relatively large urban area such as Odawara, which has around 200,000 residents, it has been very hard," he said. "In the countryside, it is much more difficult."

Iwayama's biggest problem is the country's shrinking population : fewer worshippers and falling demand for funerals and other traditional rites make it harder to finance the temple's upkeep. He has worked hard to reach out to the local community and has had success in selling plots in the temple graveyard.

One innovation that has attracted attention is the temple's "smart graveyard," where families scan a card, and a robotic system recovers a relative's ashes from the columbarium.

"Young people in villages usually leave to go to university, and then they find a job in one of the big cities, so they rarely go back," he said. "Maybe they will go back once a year to pay their respects to their ancestors at the village temple, but that is not enough for the temple to get by on."

Equally, when the head priest of a rural temple retires, his children...
body.zh: 随着人口的减少、会众的减少和经济压力的增加，寺庙正在努力保持相关性。随着越来越多的寺庙被出售或关闭，现代日本的宗教是否正在衰落？ 这座拥有 370 年历史的建筑拥有古典设计的日本寺庙的所有特征，从弧形屋顶到木结构墙壁、宽敞的榻榻米祈祷大厅和精心装饰的祭坛。 这处占地 350 平方米（3,767 平方英尺）的房产坐落在日本中部知多半岛修剪整齐的花园中，市场售价为 4.82 亿日元（266 万欧元，301 万美元）。房地产经纪人的宣传称，价格包括由“专家遗产工匠”拆除并运送到日本任何地方，在那里它将被完全修复成“令人惊叹的”两居室或三居室住宅。 这座寺庙的出售和拆除标志着它在长泽町地区山上当地社区中的作用的结束，但它的命运比日本各地的许多礼拜场所都要好。 全国大约有 77,000 座寺庙，但由于会众数量减少（特别是在人口迅速减少的农村地区）以及财政压力造成的损失，多达 17,000 座寺庙不再有全职常驻牧师。 这意味着许多寺庙正在被出售或干脆关闭，任其静静恶化。 十年前，岩山友美 (Tomomi Iwayama) 接管了位于东京西南约 80 公里（50 英里）的沿海小镇小田原废弃的甘州寺 (Ganshu-ji)。如今，他是一个不断壮大的会众的住持。 他告诉德国之声：“在我到达之前，这座寺庙已经有70年没有方丈了，因为它的运营非常困难，直到现在我才让它的财务状况回到正轨。” “即使是在像小田原这样拥有约 20 万居民的相对较大的城市地区，情况也非常困难，”他说。 “在农村，这要困难得多。” 岩山面临的最大问题是该国人口不断减少：信徒减少，葬礼和其他传统仪式的需求下降，使得寺庙的维护变得更加困难。他努力接触当地社区，并成功出售了寺庙墓地的土地。 引起关注的一项创新是寺庙的“智能墓地”，家人可以扫描卡片，机器人系统从骨灰龛中回收亲属的骨灰。 “农村的年轻人通常会离开去上大学，然后他们在大城市找到一份工作，所以他们很少回去，”他说。 “也许他们每年都会回去村里的寺庙祭拜祖先，但这不足以让寺庙维持下去。” 同样，当乡村寺庙的住持退休时，他的孩子们......

reflection.en: The news from Japan paints a stark picture of aging populations and dwindling religious communities. As temples, some centuries old, are put up for sale, it prompts reflection on what sustains a community. The psalmist reminds us that children are a heritage from Yahweh, a blessing that speaks to continuity and vitality.
reflection.zh: 日本传来的消息描绘了一幅人口老龄化和宗教社群萎缩的严峻图景。一些拥有数百年历史的寺庙被出售，这促使人们反思是什么支撑着一个社群的延续。诗人提醒我们，儿女是雅伟所赐的产业，是生命力和传承的祝福。

verse.textEn: Children are a heritage from Yahweh, offspring a reward from him.
verse.textZh: 儿女是雅伟所赐的产业。

title.en: 'We are not the AfD': Barnaby Joyce rejects German far-right question
title.zh: “我们不是德国选择党”：巴纳比·乔伊斯否认与德国极右翼有关联

summary.en: Australian MP Barnaby Joyce has stated that One Nation is not aligned with Germany's far-right party, the AfD, following the latter's significant win in a German state election. The AfD, classified as 'far-right extremist' by domestic intelligence, faces isolation as other parties refuse to cooperate with them.
summary.zh: 在德国极右翼政党德国选择党（AfD）在一场州选举中取得显著胜利后，澳大利亚议员巴纳比·乔伊斯表示，他的政党“一人党”（One Nation）与德国选择党无关。德国选择党被国内情报机构归类为“极右翼极端分子”，由于其他政党拒绝与其合作，该党在组建政府方面面临困难。

body.en:
Barnaby Joyce has sought to distance One Nation from the Alternative for Germany party (AfD), after the far-right, anti-immigration group's state election win on Sunday.

At a German state election in east-central Saxony-Anhalt, the AfD surged into first place, winning 44 per cent of the vote and delivering a significant blow to Chancellor Friedrich Merz's conservatives, while short of an overall majority.

The AfD, which has been classified as 'far-right extremist' by domestic intelligence agencies, will have a difficult time forming government as other parties have said they will refuse to cooperate.

The party is seeking to secure a foothold for advancing its agenda, which includes heavy restrictions on immigration, restoring ties with ‌Russia, cutting support to Ukraine and quitting the euro.

The election win has placed a far-right party within reach of power at the state level in Germany for the first time since World War Two.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

It's the latest indication of a surge in far-right populism across Europe over recent years.

Asked whether One Nation was taking anything from the German populist party's victory, Joyce said: "I'm not — We are not the AfD. That is a different party."

"I have a completely different view about the AfD than I would to ... say Giorgia Meloni in Italy, who is just a very direct and competent lady doing a good job."

The member for New England went on to list several world leaders and the Donald Trump-linked MAGA movement described as right-wing populists: "Well, I don't see (the UK's Reform leader Nigel Farage) as dangerous at all ... the MAGA movement, they're just conservatives, and they're deciding now whether Trump's in them or not ... Then [2027 French presidential hopeful Marine] Le Pen... I suppose Le Pen is slightly to the right but, you know, tolerable."

"We are very aware of what fascism does; it's a disgusting, horrendous thing, and it's got nothing to do with One Nation or anything I would be involved with."

Thousands of people across Germany have protested against the AfD since Sunday's election.

Protesters carried banners with slogans including "Fascism is not an alternative" and "Stop AfD Nazis! End racism and social cuts," while crowds chanted: "All together against fascism!"

body.zh: 在极右翼反移民组织德国另类选择党周日赢得州选举后，巴纳比·乔伊斯试图拉开一国党与德国选择党的距离。 在德国中东部萨克森-安哈尔特州举行的州选举中，选择党以 44% 的选票飙升至第一，虽然未能获得绝对多数席位，但对德国总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨领导的保守派造成了沉重打击。 被国内情报机构列为“极右极端分子”的德国选择党将很难组建政府，因为其他政党已表示将拒绝合作。 该党正在寻求为推进其议程奠定基础，其中包括严格限制移民、恢复与俄罗斯的关系、削减对乌克兰的支持以及退出欧元区。 这次选举的胜利使极右翼政党自第二次世界大战以来首次获得德国州一级的权力。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 这是近年来欧洲极右民粹主义激增的最新迹象。 当被问及一国党是否从德国民粹主义政党的胜利中获益时，乔伊斯说：“我没有——我们不是选择党。那是一个不同的政党。” “我对德国选择党的看法与意大利的乔治亚·梅洛尼 (Giorgia Meloni) 的看法完全不同，她是一位非常直接、能干、工作出色的女士。” 新英格兰的成员接着列出了几位世界领导人和被描述为右翼民粹主义者的与唐纳德·特朗普有关的 MAGA 运动：“嗯，​​我不认为（英国改革领袖奈杰尔·法拉奇）有任何危险......MAGA 运动，他们只是保守派，他们现在正在决定特朗普是否在其中......然后是[2027 年法国总统候选人海军陆战队]勒庞......我认为勒庞稍微偏右，但你知道，可以容忍。” “我们非常清楚法西斯主义的所作所为；这是一件令人厌恶、可怕的事情，它与一国党或我参与的任何事情都没有关系。” 自周日选举以来，德国各地数千人抗议德国选择党。 抗议者举着写有“法西斯主义不是替代方案”和“阻止德国选择党纳粹！结束种族主义和社会削减”等口号的横幅，而人群则高呼：“大家一起反对法西斯主义！” 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

Barnaby Joyce's clear rejection of association with the AfD highlights the importance of maintaining distinct political stances and seeking peaceful, constructive...
reflection.zh: 在全球政治的复杂格局中，领导人常常面临界定自身身份和价值观的挑战，尤其是在面对极端主义意识形态崛起之时。巴纳比·乔伊斯明确拒绝与德国选择党（AfD）产生关联，这凸显了保持政治立场独立性，并寻求和平、建设性交往的重要性，而非与分裂性的力量为伍。
