title.en: Why does microwaving fish smell so bad?
title.zh: 为什么微波炉加热的鱼闻起来如此糟糕？

summary.en: The common practice of microwaving fish in shared work break rooms often leads to complaints and conflict due to its strong, lingering odor. This article explores the chemical reasons behind the unpleasant smell produced when reheating fish in a microwave, which can disrupt the workplace environment and even escalate...
summary.zh: 在共享的办公室休息室里，用微波炉加热鱼类食物的做法常常因其强烈而持久的气味而引起抱怨和冲突。本文探讨了在微波炉中重新加热鱼类时产生的难闻气味背后的化学原因，这种气味会扰乱工作场所的环境，甚至可能升级为对抗。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

The work break room can be a place of rest, gossip, fun or recovery. But it can also be a cause for complaint when yesterday's fish dinner becomes a smelly microwaved lunch. For most people, microwaving fish at work is a big no-no. It has even led to armed confrontations .

But what is happening in the microwave? Is there something specific to reheating fish in the microwave that makes it particularly smelly?

One reason fish smells when you microwave it is because fish smells fundamentally fishy. Among the key chemicals that contribute to that characteristic smell is trimethylamine.

A precursor to this chemical, called trimethylamine oxide, is concentrated in fish flesh. It helps maintain the balance of minerals and chemicals inside fish in their water habitat.

Trimethylamine oxide isn't that smelly itself, but bacteria can modify it into the extremely volatile and smelly trimethylamine (which has a boiling point of only 3–4°C ).

Trimethylamine gas has a signature smell—fishy! It is also produced in the blossoms of some flowers. A beautiful-looking hawthorn bush can have a very unpleasant smell—somewhere between fish and urine.

The longer a piece of fish is kept after purchase, the more opportunity bacteria have to thrive and produce trimethylamine; in other words, fish is often strong-smelling even before it gets to the microwave.

The smell of trimethylamine can be reduced by acids. The acid turns the volatile gas into a nonvolatile salt (volatile means able to spread into the air). So it's not surprising that many fish dishes make use of acidic vinegar or lemon juice—it makes the fish less smelly.

Other key reactions in cooking fish are lipid degradation and oxidation —the breakdown of and reactions involving fats at high temperatures.

This breakdown often sends lots of small molecules into the air, which means they are more easily smelled. That's one reason fish with higher fat content (such as salmon or mackerel) generally have stronger smells and flavors when you cook them. This chemical process can smell quite delicious , as is the case for many meats when they undergo the same processes during cooking.

However, not all compounds produced during this lipid degradation process smell good. Some aldehydes—a range of compounds often released when you cook fish—are particularly " fishy ."

Many cooking methods for fish—such as steaming or poaching—are relatively gentle. Frying uses hotter, more direct heat. The amount of lipid degradation will vary with the cooking method. The more heat, the more aromas.

Microwave ovens are a remarkable innovation for heating...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 工作休息室可以是休息、闲聊、娱乐或恢复的地方。但当昨天的鱼晚餐变成臭味十足的微波炉午餐时，这也可能成为抱怨的原因。对于大多数人来说，在工作时用微波炉加热鱼是一大禁忌。甚至导致武装对抗。 但微波炉里发生了什么？在微波炉中重新加热鱼时是否有什么特殊因素导致鱼特别臭？ 当你用微波炉加热时鱼会发出气味的原因之一是因为鱼闻起来根本就是鱼腥味。造成这种特有气味的关键化学物质之一是三甲胺。 这种化学物质的前体称为三甲胺氧化物，浓缩在鱼肉中。它有助于维持水生环境中鱼类体内矿物质和化学物质的平衡。 三甲胺氧化物本身并没有那么臭，但细菌可以将其转化为极易挥发且有臭味的三甲胺（沸点仅为3-4°C）。 三甲胺气体有一种标志性的气味——鱼腥味！它也产生于一些花的花朵中。看起来很漂亮的山楂丛可能会散发出一种非常难闻的气味——介于鱼和尿之间。 鱼购买后保存的时间越长，细菌繁殖并产生三甲胺的机会就越多；换句话说，鱼在进入微波炉之前通常就带有浓烈的气味。 三甲胺的气味可以被酸减少。酸将挥发性气体转化为非挥发性盐（挥发性意味着能够扩散到空气中）。因此，许多鱼类菜肴使用酸性醋或柠檬汁也就不足为奇了——它可以减少鱼的臭味。 烹饪鱼时的其他关键反应是脂质降解和氧化——高温下脂肪的分解和涉及脂肪的反应。 这种分解通常会将大量小分子释放到空气中，这意味着它们更容易被闻到。这就是脂肪含量较高的鱼（例如鲑鱼或鲭鱼）在烹饪时通常具有更强烈的气味和味道的原因之一。这种化学过程闻起来非常美味，就像许多肉类在烹饪过程中经历相同过程时的情况一样。 然而，并非所有在脂质降解过程中产生的化合物闻起来都很好。一些醛——烹饪鱼时经常释放的一系列化合物——特别“腥”。 许多鱼类的烹饪方法（例如蒸或水煮）都相对温和。油炸使用更热、更直接的热量。脂质降解量随烹饪方法的不同而变化。热量越高，香气越多。 微波炉是加热领域的一项非凡创新......

reflection.en: The strong smell of microwaved fish can disrupt the peace of a shared workspace, turning a place of rest into one of contention. This reminds us to consider how our actions, even seemingly small ones like reheating lunch, affect those around us. Philippians 4:8 encourages us to focus on what is good and commendable, fostering a more harmonious environment...
reflection.zh: 微波炉加热的鱼散发出的强烈气味会扰乱共享工作空间的宁静，将休息之地变成争执之地。这提醒我们要注意自己的行为，即使是像加热午餐这样看似微小的事情，也会影响到周围的人。腓立比书 4:8 鼓励我们要思想那些良善、值得称赞的事，从而为所有人营造一个更和谐的环境。

verse.textEn: Whatever is true, whatever is noble, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable — think about such things.
verse.textZh: 凡是真实的、可敬的、公义的、清洁的、可爱的、有美名的，这些事你们都要思念。

title.en: Extremely massive galaxy proto-supercluster smashes distance record
title.zh: 极其巨大的星系原超星系团打破距离纪录

summary.en: An international team of astronomers has discovered the most distant progenitor to a galaxy supercluster ever, supporting theories of galaxy cluster evolution and their connection to the cosmic web. The discovery was made using data from the ODIN survey, employing the Dark Energy Camera on the Víctor M. Blanco...
summary.zh: 一个国际天文学家团队发现了迄今为止最遥远的原星系超星系团。这一发现支持了关于星系团如何演化以及它们如何与更宏大的宇宙网相连接的现有理论。该研究主要利用了在智利维克多·M·布兰科望远镜上进行的ODIN巡天数据，该望远镜配备了美国能源部制造的暗能量相机。

body.en: An international team of astronomers has discovered the most distant progenitor to a galaxy supercluster ever. The discovery supports existing theories of how galaxy clusters evolve and reveals how they are connected to the larger cosmic web. The study relies largely on data from the ODIN survey, conducted with the U.S. Department of Energy-fabricated Dark Energy Camera on the U.S. National Science Foundation Víctor M. Blanco 4-meter Telescope in Chile.
body.zh: 一个国际天文学家小组发现了有史以来最遥远的星系超星系团前身。这一发现支持了关于星系团如何演化的现有理论，并揭示了它们如何与更大的宇宙网相连。这项研究主要依赖于 ODIN 调查的数据，该调查是使用美国能源部在智利美国国家科学基金会 Víctor M. Blanco 4 米望远镜上制造的暗能量相机进行的。

reflection.en: The vastness of the universe, revealed through discoveries like this distant galaxy proto-supercluster, speaks to the grandeur of its Creator. As we gaze into the cosmic expanse, we are reminded of the immense power and intricate design of Yahweh, who named and ordered the stars.
reflection.zh: 宇宙的浩瀚，通过发现这个遥远的星系原超星系团而得以展现，这本身就彰显了其创造主的宏伟。当我们凝视宇宙的广阔时，我们被提醒雅伟那无比强大的力量和精妙的设计，是祂命名并安排了星辰的秩序。 正如诗篇所言，“诸天述说雅伟的荣耀，穹苍传扬祂的作为。” 这一发现不仅是科学的进步，更是对造物主智慧和能力的敬畏之情的邀请，激励我们以谦卑和惊奇之心去探索祂所创造的一切。

verse.textEn: The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of his hands.
verse.textZh: 诸天述说神的荣耀，穹苍传扬他的手段。

title.en: Cosmic radiation at flight altitudes rises when the sun is less active
title.zh: 飞行高度的宇宙辐射在太阳活动较少时会增加

summary.en: Radiation from space constantly enters Earth's atmosphere, but the amount reaching commercial aircraft altitudes is influenced by height, location, and solar activity. A new study using high-altitude balloon measurements in southern Israel has mapped these atmospheric changes, revealing that radiation levels at...
summary.zh: 来自太空的辐射不断进入地球大气层，但到达商用飞机高度的辐射量不仅取决于高度和地点，还取决于太阳的活动。一项基于以色列南部高空气球测量的新研究绘制了这些大气变化图，发现随着太阳活动减弱，航空高度的辐射水平会升高。

body.en: Radiation from space is constantly entering Earth's atmosphere, but how much of it reaches the altitudes used by commercial aircraft depends not only on height and location, but also on the activity of the sun. A new study based on high-altitude balloon measurements over southern Israel has mapped these changes through the atmosphere and found that radiation levels at aviation altitudes rise as solar activity falls.
body.zh: 来自太空的辐射不断进入地球大气层，但其中有多少到达商用飞机使用的高度不仅取决于高度和位置，还取决于太阳的活动。一项基于以色列南部高空气球测量的新研究绘制了大气中的这些变化图，发现航空高度的辐射水平随着太阳活动的减弱而上升。

reflection.en: The Psalmist marvels, 'The heavens declare the glory of Yahweh.' As we learn more about the intricate dance between the sun's activity and the radiation reaching us, we see the vastness and complexity of creation. This growing knowledge, like the findings from the balloon measurements over Israel, reminds us of the profound order within the universe, a...
reflection.zh: 诗人惊叹道：“诸天述说雅伟的荣耀。” 随着我们对太阳活动与到达我们辐射之间复杂互动了解的加深，我们看到了被造物的浩瀚与复杂。这种日益增长的知识，如同以色列上空气球测量所揭示的发现，提醒我们宇宙中存在着深刻的秩序，这是造物主智慧的见证。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Optimizing tomato plant growth with microbes
title.zh: 利用微生物优化番茄植株生长

summary.en: Plants host a variety of microorganisms that aid their growth and resilience against environmental stressors like high temperatures and drought, which are exacerbated by climate change. The use of biofertilizers, such as rhizosphere microorganisms, helps plants absorb nutrients and enhances their disease and stress...
summary.zh: 植物寄生着多种微生物，这些微生物有助于它们的生长并增强它们对高温和干旱等环境压力的抵抗力，而这些压力又因气候变化而加剧。生物肥料（如根际微生物）的使用有助于植物吸收养分并增强其抗病和抗逆能力。

body.en: Plants are home to a diverse array of microorganisms that support their growth and help them adapt to environmental stress—of which there has been an abundance lately. High temperatures and drought caused by human-induced climate change have led to reduced crop yields and the use of biofertilizers such as rhizosphere microorganisms, which help plants absorb nutrients and increase their resistance to disease and stress.
body.zh: 植物是多种微生物的家园，这些微生物支持它们的生长并帮助它们适应环境压力——最近这些微生物的数量非常丰富。人为引起的气候变化造成的高温和干旱导致作物产量下降，并导致根际微生物等生物肥料的使用减少，这些肥料有助于植物吸收养分并增强对疾病和胁迫的抵抗力。

reflection.en: The natural world teems with life, including the unseen microbial communities that sustain plants. Job 12:7 reminds us that even the creatures of the earth can teach us. This research into plant-microbe interactions reveals the intricate wisdom woven into creation, offering practical solutions for agriculture in a changing climate.
reflection.zh: 自然界充满了生命，包括维持植物生存的看不见的微生物群落。《约伯记》12章7节提醒我们，就连地上的生物也能教导我们。这项关于植物-微生物相互作用的研究揭示了创造中错综复杂的智慧，为应对气候变化中的农业提供了实用的解决方案。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Waterlogged seeds reveal melons' ancient journey
title.zh: 水渍种子揭示了甜瓜的古老旅程

summary.en: Melons, often symbolizing fertility and prosperity in Chinese culture due to their numerous seeds, have a complex and debated history regarding their journey to modern tables. A new study analyzing ancient DNA from seeds found at a Song dynasty imperial archaeological site in China is shedding light on this ancient...
summary.zh: 甜瓜因其种子众多，在中国文化中常象征着生育和繁荣，但其走向现代餐桌的历史却充满争议且曲折。一项对中国宋代（约公元960-1279年）皇家考古遗址中发现的种子的古DNA进行分析的新研究，正在揭示这段古老的历史。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Melons produce many seeds, making the melon shape a traditional symbol of fertility and prosperity in Chinese culture. But the historical debate about how melons made their way to modern tables is as long and twisted as the vines they grow on.

A new study published in Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences reveals newly discovered aspects of melons' ancient history. Based on an analysis of ancient DNA from seeds at a Song dynasty imperial archaeological site in southeastern China (circa 960–1279), scientists at Washington University in St. Louis have determined that ancient melons in East Asia likely arrived from South Asia, rather than being developed from wild Chinese plants, and that they lacked the sweetness of modern dessert melons.

These melons' flesh color likely resonated with Song dynasty aesthetic sensibilities, as seen in jade-green celadon ceramics that were locally crafted in melon-shaped forms.

Taken together, the study offers a rare and compelling example of how cultural tastes and crop traits may have influenced each other, the researchers said. The study is also an example of how scientists can use ancient DNA to answer historical questions beyond what macrobotanical evidence or artifacts alone can reveal.

Biologist Susanne Renner, in WashU Arts & Sciences and co-author of the new study, has studied melons for more than 25 years. "At that time, it was assumed that because the genus Cucumis, to which melons belong, has numerous wild African species, that melons originated in Africa," she said.

But Renner was never convinced. In 2010, she published a study based on some 100 Cucumis samples from Africa, Australia and Asia that showed that melon has numerous previously overlooked species-level relatives in Australia and around the Indian Ocean.

"Based on biogeographic analysis, we inferred that melons most likely originated in Asia, not Africa," Renner said. It is now clear that melon domestication occurred independently once in Northeast Africa and twice in India, but archaeobotanical evidence points to a possible additional domestication event in southeastern China.

Renner was intrigued when she sat down next to WashU colleague Xinyi Liu, a professor of archaeology in Arts & Sciences, at a WashU Living Earth Collaborative event. Liu told her about the many archaeological seeds, including those recently uncovered in an excavation of a medieval port in southeastern China.

Located in present-day Wenzhou, the Gugang port (Shuomen Gugang) helped connect continental East Asia with the Pacific and Indian Ocean worlds during the Song dynasty. An...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 瓜结出许多种子，使瓜的形状成为中国文化中生育和繁荣的传统象征。但关于瓜类如何进入现代餐桌的历史争论，就像它们生长的藤蔓一样漫长而曲折。 《美国国家科学院院刊》上发表的一项新研究揭示了瓜类古代历史的新发现。圣路易斯华盛顿大学的科学家根据对中国东南部宋代帝国考古遗址（约 960-1279 年）种子的古代 DNA 进行分析，确定东亚的古代瓜类很可能来自南亚，而不是由中国野生植物发展而来，而且它们缺乏现代甜瓜的甜味。 这些瓜的肉色可能与宋代的审美观产生共鸣，正如当地制作的瓜形形状的玉绿色青瓷陶瓷中所见。 研究人员表示，总的来说，这项研究提供了一个罕见且令人信服的例子，说明文化品味和作物特征如何相互影响。这项研究也是科学家如何利用古代 DNA 来回答历史问题的一个例子，而这些问题超出了宏观植物学证据或文物本身所能揭示的范围。 华盛顿大学艺术与科学学院的生物学家 Susanne Renner 是这项新研究的合著者，她研究瓜类已经超过 25 年了。 “当时，人们认为，由于甜瓜所属的黄瓜属有许多非洲野生物种，因此认为甜瓜起源于非洲，”她说。 但雷纳从未被说服。 2010 年，她发表了一项基于来自非洲、澳大利亚和亚洲的约 100 个黄瓜样本的研究，结果表明，在澳大利亚和印度洋周围，甜瓜有许多以前被忽视的物种级亲属。 “根据生物地​​理学分析，我们推断甜瓜很可能起源于亚洲，而不是非洲，”雷纳说。现在已经清楚，甜瓜驯化在东北非独立发生过一次，在印度独立发生过两次，但考古植物学证据表明，中国东南部可能存在额外的驯化事件。 在华盛顿大学生命地球合作活动中，当雷纳坐在华盛顿大学同事、艺术与科学考古学教授刘心怡旁边时，她感到很感兴趣。刘向她讲述了许多考古种子，包括最近在中国东南部一个中世纪港口的挖掘中发现的种子。 位于今温州的古港港（硕门古港）在宋代帮助连接了东亚大陆与太平洋和印度洋世界。一个...

reflection.en: The discovery of ancient melon seeds at a Song dynasty site offers a tangible link to the past, revealing details about the long journey of this fruit to our tables. This scientific endeavor reminds us that the natural world, even in its smallest remnants like seeds, holds profound stories and wisdom, waiting to be uncovered through careful observation and...
reflection.zh: 在宋代遗址中发现的古老甜瓜种子，提供了一个与过去息息相关的实物联系，揭示了这种水果走向我们餐桌的漫长旅程的细节。这项科学探索提醒我们，自然界，即使是像种子这样微小的遗迹，也蕴藏着深刻的故事和智慧，等待着通过细致的观察和研究被发掘出来。

title.en: NASA technique for manipulating satellite photos now reveals ancient images
title.zh: NASA技术用于处理卫星照片，现已揭示古代图像

summary.en: A technique developed at NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory, originally for manipulating satellite images, has been used to reveal faded paintings within the central tower of Angkor Wat, Cambodia. These paintings, depicting horseback riders and musicians, were discovered between 2010 and 2012 by an archaeologist using...
summary.zh: 一项最初用于处理卫星图像的NASA喷气推进实验室技术，已被用于揭示柬埔寨吴哥窟中心塔内褪色的壁画。这些描绘骑马者和音乐家的画作是在2010年至2012年间由一位考古学家使用此方法发现的，因为它们已经褪色到几乎看不见的程度。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

High in the central tower of Angkor Wat, an ancient Cambodian temple, paintings depict horseback riders and a traditional musical ensemble. Thousands of visitors pass these images daily without noticing them because they are faded to the point of invisibility.

They were discovered between 2010 and 2012, along with about 200 other paintings throughout the complex, by an archaeologist using a method conceived at NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory in Southern California.

The technique, known as decorrelation stretch, heightens contrasts in digital imagery, making features easier to spot. It is especially popular for studying ancient rock art, partly because of the chance intersection of one man's hobby and professional background.

Around 2005, rock art enthusiast Jon Harman saw NASA images depicting the Martian surface with and without decorrelation stretch. Seeing how much detail the technique revealed, Harman, now retired in Pacifica, California, understood its implications for studying ancient, faded images.

He also worked in medical imaging. "I Googled it and found a NASA paper that explained how to do the algorithm," he said. "I knew from my medical imaging experience that I could do it, so I did."

The paper was written in 1996 by Ronald Alley, a JPL employee developing applications for the Advanced Spaceborne Thermal Emission and Reflection Radiometer (ASTER), a Japanese imaging instrument on NASA's Terra satellite. One of Alley's former supervisors at JPL had coinvented decorrelation stretch, and Alley had recognized its potential for gleaning information from ASTER imagery.

Harman made his plug-in for use with ImageJ, an open-source program developed by the National Institutes of Health.

He said he fulfills about 200 requests for Dstretch per year. Around 2010, he also created smartphone apps that use a shortcut to mimic decorrelation stretch. The apps have been downloaded thousands of times, and papers have been published describing Dstretch's usefulness in archaeology.

It has been used to spot and clarify imagery at ancient sites beneath a cliff in Norway, in an Egyptian tomb, at a park in Canada and in many other locations. It has also helped archaeologists find buried remains of ancient Greek buildings and examine tattoos on mummified human remains, among its non-rock-art applications.

Harman said he was not surprised Dstretch found wide use in the rock art community. "But I've been surprised by a lot of the different applications people have found. So that's been cool."

BA art history, MA material culture. Former museum editor, paramedic, and transplant...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 在柬埔寨古老寺庙吴哥窟中央塔楼的高处，画作描绘了骑马者和传统乐团。每天都有成千上万的游客经过这些图像而没有注意到它们，因为它们已经褪色到看不见的程度。 2010 年至 2012 年间，一位考古学家利用美国宇航局南加州喷气推进实验室设想的方法，发现了这些画作以及整个建筑群中的约 200 幅其他画作。 这项技术被称为去相关拉伸，可以增强数字图像的对比度，使特征更容易被发现。它在研究古代岩石艺术方面特别受欢迎，部分原因是一个人的爱好和专业背景的偶然交叉。 2005 年左右，岩石艺术爱好者乔恩·哈曼 (Jon Harman) 看到了 NASA 的图像，这些图像描绘了有或没有去相关拉伸的火星表面。看到这项技术揭示了多少细节，现已在加利福尼亚州帕西菲卡退休的哈曼明白了它对研究古代褪色图像的意义。 他还从事医学成像工作。 “我用谷歌搜索，找到了一篇 NASA 的论文，解释了如何执行该算法，”他说。 “根据我的医学影像经验，我知道我可以做到，所以我就这么做了。” 这篇论文由罗纳德·艾利 (Ronald Alley) 于 1996 年撰写，他是喷气推进实验室的一名员工，为先进星载热发射和反射辐射计 (ASTER)（美国宇航局 Terra 卫星上的日本成像仪器）开发应用程序。艾利在喷气推进实验室的一位前主管共同发明了去相关拉伸，艾利也认识到了它从 ASTER 图像中收集信息的潜力。 Harman 制作了与 ImageJ 一起使用的插件，ImageJ 是美国国立卫生研究院开发的开源程序。 他说他每年会满足大约 200 个 Dstretch 请求。 2010 年左右，他还创建了智能手机应用程序，使用快捷方式来模拟去相关拉伸。这些应用程序已被下载数千次，并且已经发表了描述 Dstretch 在考古学中的实用性的论文。 它已被用来发现和澄清挪威悬崖下的古代遗址、埃及坟墓、加拿大公园和许多其他地点的图像。它还帮助考古学家发现埋藏的古希腊建筑遗迹，并检查木乃伊人类遗骸上的纹身，以及其非岩石艺术应用。 哈曼说，他对 Dstretch 在岩石艺术界的广泛使用并不感到惊讶。 “但我对人们发现的许多不同应用程序感到惊讶。所以这很酷。” 艺术史学士，物质文化硕士。前博物馆编辑、护理人员和移植...

reflection.en: It is a profound joy when human ingenuity, even in seemingly unrelated fields like satellite imaging, can bring hidden beauty and history back into view. This discovery at Angkor Wat reminds us that careful observation and the application of knowledge can illuminate what time and neglect have obscured, revealing the artistry and stories of those who came...
reflection.zh: 当人类的智慧，即使是在卫星成像这样看似不相关的领域，也能将隐藏的美丽和历史重新展现出来时，这是一种深刻的喜悦。吴哥窟的这一发现提醒我们，细致的观察和知识的应用可以照亮被时间和疏忽所遮蔽的事物，揭示我们先辈的艺术和故事。

verse.textEn: It is the glory of God to conceal a matter; to search out a matter is the glory of kings.
verse.textZh: 将事隐秘乃神的荣耀；将事察清乃君王的荣耀。

title.en: Are rich people really worse behaved? Here’s the science – video
title.zh: 富人真的行为更差吗？科学是这么说的——视频

summary.en: A study, which found that wealthy individuals are more likely to engage in unethical behavior, was a winner of the Ig Nobel prizes. The research suggests potential reasons for this phenomenon, alongside other award-winning studies.
summary.zh: 一项研究发现，富裕人士更有可能做出不道德的行为，并获得了2026年搞笑诺贝尔奖。该研究探讨了这一现象的潜在原因，并介绍了其他获奖研究。

body.en: Who’s more likely to steal sweets from a child? According to science, it’s the rich. A study seemingly confirming our suspicions about the moral behaviour of the wealthy was one of the winners of the 2026 Ig Nobel prizes, which honour research that makes you laugh and then think. Science editor Ian Sample tells Madeleine Finlay what the researchers think could be behind the phenomenon, and they explore some of the other awards, including one for a surprising quality we look for in our friends and another for a biomechanical definition of kissing Continue reading...
body.zh: 谁更有可能偷孩子的糖果？根据科学，这是有钱人。一项似乎证实了我们对富人道德行为的怀疑的研究成为 2026 年搞笑诺贝尔奖的获得者之一，该奖项旨在表彰那些让你开怀大笑并引发思考的研究。科学编辑伊恩·萨普告诉玛德琳·芬利，研究人员认为这一现象背后可能存在什么，他们还探讨了其他一些奖项，其中一个奖项是为了我们在朋友身上寻找的令人惊讶的品质，另一个奖项是为了对接吻的生物力学定义继续阅读...

reflection.en: This research, honored by the Ig Nobel prizes, raises questions about the relationship between wealth and morality. It prompts us to consider whether the pursuit of material gain can sometimes overshadow ethical considerations, echoing the ancient wisdom that one cannot serve both God and Mammon.
reflection.zh: 这项搞笑诺贝尔奖所表彰的研究，引发了关于财富与道德之间关系的疑问。它促使我们思考，对物质财富的追求是否有时会掩盖道德考量，这呼应了古老的智慧：人不能同时事奉神和玛门。

verse.textEn: No one can serve two masters... You cannot serve both God and Mammon.
verse.textZh: 一个人不能事奉两个主……你们不能又事奉神，又事奉玛门。

title.en: 'River is flowing better than it has for 25 years'
title.zh: 25年来河流状况最佳

summary.en: The River Deben is flowing better than it has in 25 years following major restoration efforts. Excavation and tree removal, part of a community and multi-agency initiative, have improved water flow after a weir collapse and bridge damage caused water levels to drop significantly.
summary.zh: 经过大规模修复工程后，德本河的河流状况比过去25年来都要好。挖掘和移除树木是多方机构和社区共同努力的一部分，在堰坝倒塌和桥梁损坏导致水位大幅下降后，这些工作改善了河流的流速。

body.en:
A river is flowing better than it has for a quarter of a century after a major restoration but the next stage of works will be "really critical", according to a parish councillor.

Water levels in the River Deben in Suffolk dropped by more than a metre after heavy rain caused a weir structure at Ufford, near Woodbridge, to fall away and a bridge to partially collapse.

While they are still to be fixed, water in the river is again running freely after a multi-agency and community effort saw vital excavations and tree removal take place.

Councillor David Findley, river warden at Ufford Parish Council, said it was a "really exciting moment to actually see the water flowing" again.

"This section of the river used to be cleaned out every five to 10 years, so it's not been like this for 25 years," he said.

"Now, you can see gravel bits and silt bits, and so it's actually creating a really potentially dynamic river."

The collapse in April caused a water-filled crater known as Ufford Hole to drain on to surrounding land, including on a side channel towards the East Suffolk railway line.

It happened after tree roots grew into the weir, which subsequently "fell to pieces", Finley said, resulting in "all the water" rushing towards the Hawkeswade/Lower Ufford Bridge which "cracked" it.

The Essex & Suffolk Rivers Trust said it caused "significant damage to habitats along a large stretch of the river".

A wooden walkway next to the bridge, which allows people to follow a footpath on the river bank, had to be closed off and it is still awaiting repair.

Trevor Gill, from the Lower Deben Riparian Owners Group, said the collapse had a detrimental effect on biodiversity.

"It had a really big impact on nature, but also on people who love this, people who've been fishing and swimming here for decades," he said.

"People were worried about fish dying, which did happen, and it was pretty barren.

"What we've done so far shows people that we are here to get behind this problem and fix it."

After the incident, councils and a consortium of landowners and farmers worked with the Environment Agency and others to form an action plan.

The first phase of that focused on clearing the dried-out channel from Old Melton Mill to Ufford Hole to allow water to flow back to the mill.

Now that has been achieved, attention has turned to repairing the weir before the "winter flood" and also the footpath to restore access.

"The really critical bit is getting this weir sorted out so the water doesn't just accelerate the channel and create real problems further down the river," Findley said.

River level plunges with drought. Video, 00:04:00 River level plunges with drought
body.zh: 一位教区议员表示，经过重大修复后，河流的流量比四分之一个世纪以来的情况要好，但下一阶段的工程将“非常关键”。 大雨导致伍德布里奇附近的乌福德的一个堰结构脱落，一座桥梁部分倒塌，萨福克郡德本河的水位下降了一米多。 虽然它们仍有待修复，但在多机构和社区的努力下进行了重要的挖掘和树木清除后，河水再次自由流动。 乌福德教区议会河流管理员、议员大卫·芬利表示，“再次看到水流流动真是令人兴奋的时刻”。 他说：“这一段河以前每五到十年就会被清理一次，所以已经有 25 年没有这样了。” “现在，你可以看到砾石和淤泥，因此它实际上正在创造一条真正具有潜在活力的河流。” 4 月份的塌陷导致一个名为 Ufford Hole 的充满水的火山口流到周围的土地上，包括通往东萨福克铁路线的侧通道。 芬利说，树根长进堰后，堰随后“碎裂”，导致“所有的水”涌向霍克斯瓦德/下乌福德大桥，导致堰“破裂”。 埃塞克斯和萨福克河信托基金表示，它“对沿河大片河段的栖息地造成了严重破坏”。 桥旁的一条木制走道允许人们沿着河岸的人行道行走，但不得不关闭，目前仍在等待修复。 下德本河岸业主小组的特雷弗·吉尔表示，塌方对生物多样性产生了不利影响。 “它对自然产生了巨大的影响，也对热爱这里的人们，几十年来一直在这里钓鱼和游泳的人们产生了巨大的影响，”他说。 “人们担心鱼类死亡，这种情况确实发生了，而且那里非常贫瘠。 “到目前为止，我们所做的事情向人们表明，我们是来支持这个问题并解决它的。” 事件发生后，议会以及土地所有者和农民组成的财团与环境局和其他机构合作制定了一项行动计划。 第一阶段的重点是清理从老梅尔顿磨坊到乌福德洞的干涸通道，让水流回磨坊。 既然已经实现了这一目标，人们的注意力就转向在“冬季洪水”到来之前修复堰以及恢复通道的人行道。 芬利说：“真正关键的一点是解决这个堰，这样水就不会加速河道流速，并在河流下游造成真正的问题。” 在 BBC Sounds、Facebook、external、Instagram、external 和 X, external 上关注萨福克新闻。 河流水位因干旱而下降。视频，00:04:00 河流水位因干旱而暴跌

reflection.en: It is encouraging to see the River Deben flowing freely again after significant restoration work. This success, achieved through collaborative effort, reminds us of the goodness of creation and our role in its care. May this restoration inspire continued stewardship and a deep appreciation for the natural world Yahweh has made.
reflection.zh: 看到德本河经过大规模修复工程后再次自由流淌，令人鼓舞。这项通过共同努力取得的成功，提醒我们受造物的良善以及我们在其照管中的作用。愿这次修复能激励我们继续尽责，并深深地欣赏雅伟所造的自然世界。

verse.textEn: God saw all that he had made, and it was very good.
verse.textZh: 神看着一切所造的都甚好。

title.en: Scientists discover a powerful new antivenom hidden in rattlesnake blood
title.zh: 科学家在响尾蛇血液中发现强效新抗蛇毒剂

summary.en: Researchers have discovered that combinations of toxin-blocking proteins naturally present in rattlesnake blood can effectively neutralize venom from several dangerous snake species. Laboratory tests showed these mixtures were approximately 10 times more potent than a current commercial antivenom, suggesting a...
summary.zh: 研究人员发现，响尾蛇血液中天然存在的毒素阻断蛋白组合能够有效中和多种危险蛇类的毒液。实验室测试表明，这些混合物的效力约为当前市售抗蛇毒剂的10倍，为治疗蛇咬伤开辟了一条有前景的新途径。

body.en:
University of Maryland researchers have identified a promising new way to treat venomous snakebites by borrowing from snakes' own natural defenses. Their approach uses toxin-blocking proteins that western diamondback rattlesnakes evolved to protect themselves from venom.

By combining specific proteins found in rattlesnake blood, the researchers achieved unusually strong protection against venom from several dangerous snake species.

The study was led by Distinguished University Professor of BiologySean B. Carroll and published in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences . The findings could help researchers develop more powerful antivenoms for deadly snakebites, which remain a major health threat in some regions of the world.

"This is one of those great stories when nature has already solved a problem we've been grappling with for decades," said Carroll, who also holds the Andrew and Mary Balo and Nicholas and Susan Simon Endowed Chair at UMD.

Snakebite is considered one of the world's most neglected tropical diseases. According to the World Health Organization, venomous snakes kill an estimated 80,000 to 140,000 people annually, while hundreds of thousands of survivors are left with permanent disabilities. Many of those affected live in rural areas where effective antivenom can be difficult to obtain.

Existing antivenoms save lives, but they also have major drawbacks. They are typically produced by exposing large animals to snake venom and then collecting the antibodies those animals generate. Manufacturing these treatments can be costly, their quality and effectiveness can vary, and they may not work equally well against the many different toxins found in venom from different snake species. They can also cause serious immune reactions.

Those limitations have pushed scientists to search for better options. In this case, the researchers turned to snakes themselves for clues.

"We've known from anecdotes for 100 years that vipers tend to be resistant to their own venom," Carroll said. "But for a long time, nobody knew what exactly was circulating in their blood that protected them."

In 2022, Carroll's laboratory found part of the answer: a protein called FETUA-3. The researchers discovered that it could block the activity of many metalloproteinase toxins found in western diamondback rattlesnake venom. It could also bind to and inhibit toxins from the venoms of several other rattlesnake species.

"Here was evolution's way for snakes to protect themselves from accidental self-envenomation," he said, which prompted a follow-up question. "Why rely on horse antibodies when nature has packaged an effective antidote right there in the snake?"

For the new research, co-authors including Elda Sánchez, director of the National Natural...
body.zh: 马里兰大学的研究人员利用蛇自身的自然防御能力，发现了一种治疗毒蛇咬伤的有前途的新方法。他们的方法使用西方小菜斑响尾蛇进化来的毒素阻断蛋白来保护自己免受毒液的侵害。 通过结合响尾蛇血液中发现的特定蛋白质，研究人员获得了针对几种危险蛇类毒液的异常强大的保护作用。 该研究由杰出大学生物学教授肖恩·B·卡罗尔（Sean B. Carroll）领导，并发表在《美国国家科学院院刊》上。这些发现可以帮助研究人员开发出更强大的抗蛇毒血清来治疗致命的蛇咬伤，蛇咬伤仍然是世界某些地区的主要健康威胁。 “这是一个伟大的故事，大自然已经解决了我们几十年来一直在努力解决的问题，”卡罗尔说，他也是马里兰大学安德鲁和玛丽巴洛以及尼古拉斯和苏珊西蒙捐赠主席。 蛇咬伤被认为是世界上最被忽视的热带疾病之一。据世界卫生组织称，毒蛇每年导致约 80,000 至 140,000 人死亡，数十万幸存者留下永久性残疾。许多受影响者生活在农村地区，那里很难获得有效的抗蛇毒血清。 现有的抗蛇毒血清可以挽救生命，但它们也有重大缺点。它们通常是通过将大型动物暴露于蛇毒中，然后收集这些动物产生的抗体来产生的。制造这些治疗方法可能成本高昂，其质量和效果也各不相同，而且它们对于不同蛇类毒液中发现的多种不同毒素的效果可能不同。它们还会引起严重的免疫反应。 这些限制促使科学家寻找更好的选择。在这种情况下，研究人员转向蛇本身寻找线索。 卡罗尔说：“我们从 100 年来的轶事中得知，毒蛇往往对自己的毒液有抵抗力。” “但很长一段时间，没有人知道他们的血液中到底循环着什么来保护他们。” 2022 年，卡罗尔的实验室找到了部分答案：一种名为 FETUA-3 的蛋白质。研究人员发现，它可以阻止西方小菜斑响尾蛇毒液中发现的许多金属蛋白酶毒素的活性。它还可以结合并抑制其他几种响尾蛇物种的毒液中的毒素。 “这是蛇的进化方式，可以保护自己免受意外的自我毒害，”他说，这引发了一个后续问题。 “当大自然已经在蛇体内包装了有效的解毒剂时，为什么还要依赖马抗体呢？” 对于这项新研究，合著者包括国家自然科学中心主任埃尔达·桑切斯……

reflection.en: The natural world is a testament to Yahweh's intricate design and wisdom. In this case, the very creatures that possess dangerous venom also hold the key to its neutralization within their own biology. This discovery reminds us that by observing and understanding creation, we can uncover profound solutions and appreciate the Creator's ingenuity.
reflection.zh: 大自然是雅伟精妙设计和智慧的明证。在此案例中，拥有剧毒的生物本身也蕴藏着中和毒液的关键。这一发现提醒我们，通过观察和理解受造界，我们可以揭示深刻的解决方案，并欣赏创造者的奇思妙想。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Your personality may be more genetic than scientists realized
title.zh: 你的个性可能比科学家们意识到的更具遗传性

summary.en: A study has identified over 1,200 genetic variants associated with the Big Five personality traits, suggesting a significant genetic link between personality and various life outcomes such as health, longevity, careers, and income. The research involved an international collaboration analyzing data from 46 cohorts...
summary.zh: 一项研究确定了与“大五”人格特质相关的1200多个基因变异，表明人格与健康、寿命、职业和收入等多种生活结果之间存在显著的遗传联系。该研究涉及一项国际合作，分析了来自全球46个研究队列的数据。

body.en:
An international team of scientists has identified more than 1,200 genetic variants associated with the Big Five personality traits. The findings also suggest that many of the same genetic patterns connected to personality are related to a wide range of life outcomes, including health, longevity, education, careers, and income.

The study, led by the Revived Genomics of Personality Consortium, brought together data from 46 research cohorts around the world. Participants provided DNA samples and completed questionnaires designed to measure the Big Five personality traits: openness to experience, conscientiousness, extraversion, agreeableness and neuroticism.

These traits describe relatively stable patterns in how people tend to think, feel, and behave. Researchers compared participants' genetic data with differences in their personality scores to identify genetic variants associated with each trait.

"There is no single 'personality gene,'" said Ted Schwaba, lead author of this study and faculty at MSU's Department of Psychology. "Personality traits are associated with many genetic variants, but even the largest effects of individual genetic variants are still very small. However, even though any individual genetic variant makes very little difference in personality, the effects of many variants together can be more sizeable."

Although the influence of any one genetic variant was tiny, the researchers found that their combined effects were more substantial and consistent. The genetic patterns also appeared to hold across very different groups of people.

For instance, variants associated with extraversion in a young adult living in the Netherlands could also help predict extraversion in an older retired adult in the United States. By using methods that compared relatives with one another, the team found evidence that these genetic associations could not simply be explained by growing up in the same environment.

Even so, genetics is only part of the picture. The findings also reinforced the important role that a person's environment plays in shaping personality.

The researchers found that genetic variants associated with personality overlap with genetic patterns connected to many other areas of life. These include mental and physical health, longevity, education, career choices and outcomes, as well as the way people are viewed by those close to them.

Some of the links involved everyday habits. Genetic variants associated with conscientiousness were also related to being more active during the daytime. Meanwhile, variants associated with openness to experience and extraversion were connected with a greater tendency to be a night owl.

The results also highlight how genetics and environment can interact with one another rather than operating...
body.zh: 一个国际科学家团队已鉴定出 1,200 多种与“大五人格”特征相关的基因变异。研究结果还表明，许多与性格相关的相同遗传模式与广泛的生活结果相关，包括健康、长寿、教育、职业和收入。 这项研究由复兴人格基因组学联盟 (Revived Genomics of Personality Consortium) 领导，汇集了来自全球 46 个研究队列的数据。参与者提供了 DNA 样本并完成了旨在衡量五大人格特征的调查问卷：开放性、责任心、外向性、宜人性和神经质。 这些特征描述了人们如何思考、感受和行为的相对稳定的模式。研究人员将参与者的遗传数据与他们的性格评分差异进行比较，以确定与每个特征相关的遗传变异。 “不存在单一的‘人格基因’，”这项研究的主要作者、密歇根州立大学心理学系的教员泰德·施瓦巴 (Ted Schwaba) 说。 “人格特征与许多遗传变异有关，但即使单个遗传变异的最大影响仍然很小。然而，即使任何单个遗传变异对人格的影响很小，但许多变异加在一起的影响可能会更大。” 尽管任何一种遗传变异的影响都很微小，但研究人员发现它们的综合影响更为实质性和一致。这些遗传模式似乎也适用于非常不同的人群。 例如，与生活在荷兰的年轻人的外向性相关的变异也可以帮助预测美国老年退休成年人的外向性。通过使用相互比较亲属的方法，研究小组发现证据表明这些遗传关联不能简单地用在同一环境中长大来解释。 即便如此，遗传学只是问题的一部分。研究结果还强调了一个人的环境在塑造人格方面所发挥的重要作用。 研究人员发现，与性格相关的遗传变异与与生活许多其他领域相关的遗传模式重叠。这些因素包括身心健康、寿命、教育、职业选择和结果，以及亲近的人看待人们的方式。 有些链接涉及日常习惯。与责任心相关的基因变异也与白天更加活跃有关。与此同时，与开放经验和外向性相关的变异与夜猫子的更大倾向有关。 结果还强调了遗传和环境如何相互作用而不是操作......

reflection.en: This research reveals a deep genetic connection to our personalities, suggesting that much of who we are is woven into our very being. It echoes the ancient wisdom that creation itself, in its intricate design, speaks of the Creator's profound knowledge and the complex tapestry of human life.
reflection.zh: 这项研究揭示了与我们个性深厚的遗传联系，表明我们很大程度上是被编织进我们自身的存在中的。它呼应了古老的智慧，即创造本身，以其错综复杂的设计，诉说着造物主深邃的知识和人类生命的复杂织锦。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Ozempic and Wegovy may have an unexpected mental health benefit
title.zh: 奥泽平与韦戈维可能带来意想不到的心理健康益处

summary.en: Semaglutide, the active ingredient in Ozempic and Wegovy, has been linked in a large Swedish study to a 21% lower risk of psychiatric hospitalization among nearly 15,000 individuals with bipolar disorder. Researchers hypothesize that its effects on inflammation and biological pathways in the brain may contribute to...
summary.zh: 在奥泽平（Ozempic）和韦戈维（Wegovy）中发现的司美格鲁肽（Semaglutide）成分，在一项对近15,000名双相情感障碍患者的大型瑞典研究中，与精神科住院风险降低21%相关。研究人员推测，其对炎症和大脑生物通路的影响可能有助于稳定情绪，尽管其他GLP-1类药物未显示出相同的关联性。

body.en: Semaglutide, the drug behind Ozempic and Wegovy, may have benefits that extend well beyond weight loss and diabetes. In a large Swedish study of nearly 15,000 people with bipolar disorder, its use was linked to a 21% lower risk of psychiatric hospitalization. Researchers think effects on inflammation and brain-related biological pathways could help stabilize mood, though other GLP-1 drugs did not show the same association.
body.zh: Ozempic 和 Wegovy 背后的药物索马鲁肽的益处可能远远超出减肥和糖尿病的范围。瑞典一项针对近 15,000 名双相情感障碍患者的大型研究显示，使用该药物可将精神病住院风险降低 21%。研究人员认为，对炎症和大脑相关生物通路的影响可能有助于稳定情绪，但其他 GLP-1 药物并未显示出相同的关联。

reflection.en: This news offers a glimmer of hope for individuals navigating the complexities of bipolar disorder. The potential for a medication, primarily known for weight management, to also contribute to mental stability and reduce psychiatric hospitalizations is a significant development. It reminds us that healing can come through unexpected avenues, and that...
reflection.zh: 这一消息为那些应对双相情感障碍复杂性的人们带来了一线希望。一种主要以体重管理而闻名的药物，竟然也能帮助稳定精神状态并减少精神科住院，这是一个重要的进展。它提醒我们，治愈可能来自意想不到的途径，并且持续的研究不断揭示支持心理健康的新方法。

verse.textEn: When they came to Jesus, they saw the man who had been possessed by the legion of demons, sitting there, dressed and in his right mind; and they were afraid.
verse.textZh: 他们来到耶稣那里，看见那被鬼附着的人，就是从前被群鬼所附的，坐着，穿上衣服，心里明白过来，他们就害怕。

title.en: Giant new dinosaur discovered beneath construction site in Brazil
title.zh: 巴西建筑工地发现巨型新恐龙

summary.en: Scientists have identified a giant new dinosaur species in Brazil, named Dasosaurus tocantinensis, which lived approximately 120 million years ago and measured about 20 meters in length. Its fossils were unearthed during construction work, and its evolutionary connection to a Spanish dinosaur suggests ancient land...
summary.zh: 科学家在巴西发现了一种新的巨型恐龙物种，名为“托坎廷斯达氏恐龙”（Dasosaurus tocantinensis），生活在大约1.2亿年前，体长约20米。其化石是在建筑工地施工期间出土的，它与一种西班牙恐龙的进化联系表明，古老的陆桥促进了这些生物跨大陆的传播。

body.en:
A newly identified dinosaur species discovered during construction work in northeastern Brazil is offering fresh clues about how giant dinosaurs spread across ancient continents.

The species, named Dasosaurus tocantinensis , is described in a study published in the Journal of Systematic Palaeontology . The animal measured about 20 meters long and lived roughly 120 million years ago. Its fossils were found at the site of a road rail terminal under construction in Davinópolis, a city in the state of Maranhão.

One of the most striking aspects of the discovery is the dinosaur's evolutionary connection to Europe. Its closest known relative lived in what is now Spain, suggesting that these animals belonged to a broader lineage that once occupied regions that are now separated by the Atlantic Ocean.

Researchers propose that the ancestors of Dasosaurus tocantinensis reached South America by moving through North Africa sometime between 140 and 120 million years ago. At the time, these landmasses were still connected within the supercontinent Gondwana.

"It's the largest known dinosaur for Maranhão, which has other species, but not sauropods like this one; rather, it has smaller ones, such as the diplodocid Amazonsaurus maranhensis , which was about 10 meters long," says Elver Luiz Mayer, a professor at the Federal University of the São Francisco Valley (UNIVASF) in the state of Bahia.

Mayer normally studies mammals from the Quaternary period, which is far more recent than the age of the dinosaur fossils. He became involved with the find in 2021 while working in São Félix do Xingu in the state of Pará, where he was then a professor at the Federal University of Southern and Southeastern Pará (UNIFESSPA)

The fossils had been uncovered by archaeologists who were monitoring the Davinópolis construction project as part of environmental licensing requirements. At first, the remains were thought to belong to large prehistoric mammals that may have lived alongside ancient humans.

"Given its depth of about eight meters, I realized that it was much older. The age of the geological formation was already known from previous research and indicated that it was material from the transition from the Lower to the Upper Cretaceous, about 120 million years ago," says Mayer. He then contacted various specialists and formed a multidisciplinary group to study the specimen.

The fossils went through an extensive preparation process before being analyzed in Pará. Afterward, the specimen was returned to Maranhão. It is now kept in São Luís, the state capital, at the State Center for Natural History and Archaeology Research, which also took part in the research.

The preserved skeleton...
body.zh: 在巴西东北部的建筑工程中发现的一种新发现的恐龙物种为巨型恐龙如何在古代大陆上传播提供了新的线索。 《系统古生物学杂志》上发表的一项研究描述了该物种，名为 Dasosaurus tocantinensis。这种动物身长约 20 米，生活在大约 1.2 亿年前。它的化石是在马拉尼昂州达维诺波利斯市正在建设的公路铁路终点站现场发现的。 这一发现最引人注目的方面之一是恐龙与欧洲的进化联系。它的已知近亲生活在现在的西班牙，这表明这些动物属于一个更广泛的谱系，这个谱系曾经占据了现在被大西洋隔开的地区。 研究人员推测，托坎蒂大索龙的祖先在 140 至 1.2 亿年前的某个时间穿过北非到达南美洲。当时，这些大陆在冈瓦纳超大陆内仍然是相连的。 巴伊亚州圣弗朗西斯科河谷联邦大学 (UNIVASF) 教授埃尔弗·路易斯·梅耶尔 (Elver Luiz Mayer) 表示：“它是马拉尼昂州已知最大的恐龙，马拉尼昂州还有其他物种，但没有像这样的蜥脚类恐龙；相反，它有较小的恐龙，例如梁龙科亚马逊龙 maranhensis，长约 10 米。” 梅耶尔通常研究第四纪时期的哺乳动物，该时期比恐龙化石的时代要晚得多。 2021 年，他在帕拉州圣费利克斯杜辛古 (São Félix do Xingu) 工作时参与了这一发现，当时他是帕拉州南和东南联邦大学 (UNIFESSPA) 的教授 这些化石是由考古学家发现的，他们正在监测达维诺波利斯建设项目，作为环境许可要求的一部分。起初，这些遗骸被认为属于大型史前哺乳动物，它们可能与古人类生活在一起。 “考虑到它的深度约为八米，我意识到它的年龄要大得多。从之前的研究中已经知道了地质构造的年龄，并表明它是大约 1.2 亿年前从下白垩纪到上白垩纪过渡的物质，”梅耶尔说。然后，他联系了多位专家，组建了一个多学科小组来研究该标本。 这些化石在帕拉州进行分析之前经过了广泛的准备过程。随后，标本被送回马拉尼昂州。它现在保存在州首府圣路易斯的国家自然历史和考古研究中心，该中心也参与了这项研究。 保存完好的骨架...

reflection.en: The discovery of Dasosaurus tocantinensis, unearthed by chance during construction, reminds us that the earth holds many secrets, waiting to be revealed through diligent study. Job 12:7-9 speaks of asking the animals and birds, the fish and the earth, for wisdom, for all of them teach us. This new dinosaur, bridging continents through ancient land...
reflection.zh: 在建筑施工中偶然发现的托坎廷斯达氏恐龙，提醒我们大地隐藏着许多秘密，等待着通过勤奋的研究被揭示。约伯记12:7-9说，你可以问走兽，它们会教导你；天空的飞鸟，它们也会告诉你。这些古老陆桥连接的跨大陆恐龙，证明了当我们观察和学习创造时，可以揭示生命的复杂历史。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Scientists observe Einstein’s gravity in the quantum world for the first time
title.zh: 科学家首次在量子世界中观测到爱因斯坦的引力

summary.en: Physicists have directly observed a long-predicted quantum effect of gravity, confirming a key aspect of Einstein's theory of gravity under quantum conditions. The experiment involved splitting an atom's quantum wave, with one part held stationary and the other falling freely.
summary.zh: 物理学家首次直接观测到了引力的一个长期预测的量子效应，在量子条件下对爱因斯坦引力理论的一个关键方面进行了验证。该实验涉及将一个原子的量子波一分为二，一部分保持静止，另一部分自由下落。

body.en:
An international team that includes Nobel Prize-winning physicist Professor Sir Roger Penrose has directly observed a long-predicted gravitational effect in a falling quantum object for the first time. The finding shows that a central principle of Einstein's theory of gravity continues to agree with quantum behavior under the conditions tested. The research, led by Ben-Gurion University of the Negev, the University of Ulm and the University of Oxford, was published September 2 in Science Advances .

Modern physics rests on two remarkably successful frameworks. Quantum mechanics describes the unusual behavior of atoms and other extremely small objects, while Einstein's theory of gravity explains falling bodies and the large-scale structure of the Universe. Despite their individual success, physicists still do not have a complete theory that brings the two together.

The new experiment explores a region where these two descriptions overlap. Researchers measured a specific change in the quantum properties of atoms as they moved under the influence of gravity. The effect matched the prediction that follows when Einstein's equivalence principle, one of the foundations of his theory of gravity, is extended to a quantum object.

The equivalence principle says that gravity should effectively vanish locally for an observer in free fall. A person falling freely in a lift, for example, would experience weightlessness. The principle has been confirmed with extraordinary precision using ordinary matter, but testing it directly with quantum objects has been much more difficult because quantum objects can behave like waves and can effectively follow more than one path at the same time.

To make such a test possible, the team built an instrument called the Quantum Galileo Interferometer. The device allowed the researchers to split the quantum wave associated with an atom into two separate paths. One part could be kept in place while the other was allowed to fall freely. The two were then brought back together so the researchers could determine how gravity had affected the falling wave.

The experiment was carried out at Ben-Gurion University using clouds of rubidium atoms cooled to temperatures just above absolute zero. The atoms were manipulated near the surface of a specially designed atom chip.

The experimental team, including PhD student Or Dobkowski, began by using microwave pulses to place the ultracold atoms into a quantum superposition. This effectively allowed each atom to follow two paths at once.

Tiny electrical wires built into the chip then generated carefully controlled magnetic fields. One part of the atomic wave interacted with the magnetic field, allowing the researchers to create an upward force that precisely balanced the downward pull of...
body.zh: 包括诺贝尔奖获得者物理学家教授罗杰·彭罗斯爵士在内的国际团队首次直接观察到了下落量子物体中长期预测的引力效应。这一发现表明，爱因斯坦引力理论的核心原理在测试条件下仍然与量子行为一致。这项研究由内盖夫本古里安大学、乌尔姆大学和牛津大学领导，于 9 月 2 日发表在《科学进展》杂志上。 现代物理学依赖于两个非常成功的框架。量子力学描述了原子和其他极小物体的异常行为，而爱因斯坦的引力理论则解释了下落物体和宇宙的大尺度结构。尽管物理学家取得了个人的成功，但他们仍然没有一个完整的理论将两者结合在一起。 新实验探索了这两种描述重叠的区域。研究人员测量了原子在重力影响下移动时量子特性的特定变化。这一效应与爱因斯坦引力理论的基础之一——等效原理扩展到量子物体时所做出的预测相符。 等效原理表明，对于自由落体的观察者来说，重力应该有效地局部消失。例如，一个人在电梯里自由落体时会体验到失重的感觉。这一原理已通过普通物质以极高的精度得到证实，但直接用量子物体对其进行测试要困难得多，因为量子物体的行为可以像波一样，并且可以有效地同时遵循多个路径。 为了使这样的测试成为可能，该团队建造了一种称为量子伽利略干涉仪的仪器。该设备允许研究人员将与原子相关的量子波分成两个独立的路径。一部分可以固定在适当的位置，而另一部分则可以自由落下。然后将两者重新放在一起，以便研究人员能够确定重力如何影响下落的波浪。 该实验是在本古里安大学进行的，使用冷却至略高于绝对零温度的铷原子云。原子在专门设计的原子芯片表面附近被操纵。 包括博士生 Or Dobkowski 在内的实验团队首先使用微波脉冲将超冷原子置于量子叠加态。这有效地允许每个原子同时遵循两条路径。 芯片内置的微小电线会产生精心控制的磁场。原子波的一部分与磁场相互作用，使研究人员能够产生一种向上的力，精确地平衡向下的拉力……

reflection.en: The heavens declare the glory of Yahweh, and the deep things of creation reveal His wisdom. This experiment, observing gravity's quantum effects, is a testament to the intricate order of the universe that scientists continue to uncover. It reminds us that even in the smallest, most complex realms, the Creator's handiwork is evident, inviting awe and further...
reflection.zh: 诸天述说雅伟的荣耀，创造的深奥之处彰显祂的智慧。这项观测引力量子效应的实验，证明了宇宙精妙的秩序，科学家们正不断揭示它。这提醒我们，即使在最小、最复杂的领域，造物主的作为也是显而易见的，引人惊叹并进一步探索。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: How meteorologists recreated weather that helped decide second world war
title.zh: 气象学家如何重现了决定第二次世界大战的天气

summary.en: Meteorologists assisted in recreating weather scenes for the film 'Pressure,' which dramatizes the critical period leading up to the D-day landings in June 1944. The film focuses on the true story of meteorologist Gp Capt James Stagg, who had to advise General Eisenhower on the suitability of weather conditions for...
summary.zh: 气象学家协助重现了电影《压力》中的天气场景，该片描绘了1944年6月诺曼底登陆前夕的关键时期。电影聚焦于气象学家詹姆斯·斯塔格（James Stagg）的真实故事，他必须就天气条件是否适合入侵向艾森豪威尔将军提供建议，而一场迫近的风暴使这一决定变得复杂。

body.en: Experts helped guide weather scenes in Pressure – a film depicting dramatic buildup to 1944’s D-day landings Dressed in a Royal Air Force uniform and sporting a trim moustache, Andrew Scott looks slightly queasy – as well he might. Behind him is a huge map of the Channel, and in front of him is Brendan Fraser, looming with a request: “I need a forecast,” he says. Starring in the film Pressure, based on a true story, Scott plays the meteorologist Gp Capt James Stagg – the man who must tell Gen Eisenhower – played by Fraser – whether conditions will be suitable for the D-day landings scheduled to take place on 5 June 1944. But a large storm is approaching the Normandy coast. Continue reading...
body.zh: 专家们帮助指导了《压力》中的天气场景——这部影片描绘了 1944 年诺曼底登陆的戏剧性场面。安德鲁·斯科特穿着皇家空军制服，留着整齐的小胡子，看起来有点恶心——他可能也有这种感觉。他身后是一张巨大的英吉利海峡地图，面前是布伦丹·弗雷泽 (Brendan Fraser)，他若隐若现地提出请求：“我需要天气预报，”他说。在根据真实故事改编的电影《压力》中，斯科特饰演气象学家詹姆斯·斯塔格上尉，他必须告诉弗雷泽饰演的艾森豪威尔将军，条件是否适合计划于 1944 年 6 月 5 日进行的诺曼底登陆。但是一场大风暴正在逼近诺曼底海岸。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The story of the D-day landings hinges on a critical forecast, a moment where human knowledge met the unpredictable forces of nature. In the face of immense pressure and uncertainty, the need for wisdom was paramount. James 1:5 reminds us that when faced with such weighty decisions, we can ask Yahweh for the discernment needed to navigate complex...
reflection.zh: 诺曼底登陆的故事围绕着一次关键的天气预报展开，那是人类知识与不可预测的自然力量交汇的时刻。面对巨大的压力和不确定性，智慧的需求至关重要。雅各书1:5提醒我们，当面对如此重大的决定时，我们可以向雅伟祈求所需的洞察力，以应对复杂的情况。

verse.textEn: If any of you lacks wisdom, you should ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault.
verse.textZh: 你们中间若有缺少智慧的，应当求那厚赐与众人、也不斥责人的神，主就必赐给他。

title.en: Site investigated over medical waste dumping claims
title.zh: 一处地点因涉嫌非法倾倒医疗废物而受到调查

summary.en: The Environment Agency is investigating a site near Wadborough, Worcestershire, following claims that medical waste was illegally dumped and spread using farm equipment. The land is adjacent to Great Blaythorn Meadow, a Site of Special Scientific Interest.
summary.zh: 在有指控称医疗废物被非法倾倒并使用农用设备散播之后，环境署正在调查伍斯特郡瓦德伯勒附近的一处地点。该地块毗邻被列为特殊科学价值保护区的格雷特·布莱瑟恩草甸。

body.en:
Land that borders a protected nature site is being investigated over claims it is being used as an illegal site to dump medical waste.

The Environment Agency (EA) said it was investigating the site off Mill Lane, near Wadborough, in Worcestershire. The land is near Great Blaythorn Meadow, which is a Site of Special Scientific Interest (SSSI).

A resident in the area, who asked not to be named, told the BBC a muck spreader, which are normally used to distribute farmyard manure, had been used to spread medical waste.

The EA said it was investigating alongside West Mercia Police, Wychavon District Council and Worcestershire County Council.

An EA spokesperson said: "Waste crime scars communities and the environment and, in line with our 10-point plan, we're acting quickly to tackle illegal activity."

The resident said they were concerned by how close the site was in relation to Great Blaythorn Meadow, which Natural England lists as an SSSI. , external

Natural England considers the land special for its biological interest, specifically wanting to protect its rare lowland meadow and grassland habitat.

The resident claimed "local residents of Wadborough and Drakes Broughton had identified some of the spread waste as medical in origin" and "estimated that 300 tonnes of contaminated waste has been spread on the field".

However, the EA has not confirmed the nature of the waste or how much waste has been dumped.

Photos said to be taken at the scene show small scraps of metal and plastic scattered across the area which is under investigation.

In December 2025, the BBC revealed a site off Mill Lane was under investigation for illegal waste dumping .

At the time, it became the third site in Worcestershire being investigated for illegal waste dumping.

The EA said it was "pulling every lever available" to "disrupt those who profit from the harm illegal waste sites cause".

Follow BBC Hereford & Worcester on BBC Sounds , Facebook , external , X , external and Instagram , external .
body.zh: 与自然保护区接壤的土地正在接受调查，因为据称该土地被用作倾倒医疗废物的非法场所。 环境局（EA）表示正在调查伍斯特郡沃德伯勒附近米尔巷附近的现场。该土地靠近大布莱索恩草甸 (Great Blaythorn Meadow)，该草甸是一个具有特殊科学价值 (SSSI) 的地点。 该地区一位不愿透露姓名的居民告诉英国广播公司，一台通常用于分发农家肥的撒粪机已被用来撒播医疗废物。 EA 表示正在与西麦西亚警方、Wychavon 地区议会和伍斯特郡议会一起进行调查。 EA 发言人表示：“废物犯罪给社区和环境带来了创伤，根据我们的 10 点计划，我们正在迅速采取行动打击非法活动。” 该居民表示，他们对该地点与 Great Blaythorn Meadow 的距离有多近感到担忧，而 Great Blaythorn Meadow 被《自然英格兰》列为 SSSI。 , 外部 自然英格兰认为这片土地因其生物利益而特殊，特别希望保护其稀有的低地草甸和草原栖息地。 该居民声称，“沃德伯勒和德雷克斯布劳顿的当地居民已确定一些散布的废物是医用废物”，并“估计现场散布了 300 吨受污染的废物”。 然而，环境署尚未确认废物的性质或倾倒了多少废物。 据称在现场拍摄的照片显示，正在调查的区域散布着细小的金属和塑料碎片。 2025 年 12 月，BBC 透露米尔巷附近的一处地点因非法倾倒废物而正在接受调查。 当时，它成为伍斯特郡第三个因非法倾倒垃圾而受到调查的地点。 EA 表示，它正在“动用一切可用的手段”来“扰乱那些从非法垃圾场造成的危害中获利的人”。 在 BBC Sounds、Facebook、external、X、external 和 Instagram、external 上关注 BBC Hereford & Worcester。

reflection.en: The report of medical waste being improperly handled raises concerns about accountability and the health of the environment. Micah 6:8 calls us to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with Yahweh, reminding us that our stewardship of creation and our treatment of communities are matters of deep spiritual significance. May this investigation bring clarity...
reflection.zh: 关于医疗废物处理不当的报道，引发了对问责制和环境健康的担忧。弥迦书6:8呼吁我们行公义、好怜悯、谦卑地与雅伟同行，提醒我们，我们对受造界的管理和对社区的对待，都是具有深远属灵意义的事情。 愿此次调查带来清晰，并确保责任人受到追究，从而保护自然界和附近居民的福祉。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Shetland spaceport project secures £30m of UK government investment
title.zh: 萨克萨沃德太空港项目获得英国政府3000万英镑投资

summary.en: The UK government has announced an investment of £30 million in the SaxaVord Spaceport in Shetland, which will be used to construct two additional launchpads. This funding is part of a new national space strategy and is expected to unlock further private investment.
summary.zh: 英国政府宣布向设在设得兰群岛的萨克萨沃德太空港投资3000万英镑，这笔资金将用于建造另外两个发射台。这项投资是国家太空战略的一部分，预计还将吸引更多的私人投资。

body.en:
The UK government has announced investment of £30m in SaxaVord Spaceport in Shetland as part of a new national space strategy.

A spaceport spokesperson said the funding was a "hugely significant" vote of confidence and would unlock a further £30m of private investment.

Several companies hope to use SaxaVord in Unst, the northernmost point in the UK, as a launch site for small commercial rockets.

A government spokesperson said space was "an increasingly important domain" for keeping the country safe.

SaxaVord is the UK's first fully-licensed spaceport and has regulatory approval for up to 30 rocket launches a year.

The company said the £60m public-private investment package would be used to design and build a second hangar and two more launchpads.

Chief executive officer Scott Hammond said the funding would take the company to the next stage of its development.

"We are building the spaceport for the thousandth as much as the first launch," he said.

"We're trying to create a successful, safe and sustainable business. This is direct investment into Shetland."

Rocket Factory Augsburg (RFA) is working towards its first vertical orbital test flight from UK soil. In August, SaxaVord paused plans for a test launch after RFA said it had "encountered an issue".

A five-week "launch window" had been due to begin, with temporary traffic restrictions introduced in the event of a flight attempt.

A second company, HyImpulse Technologies GmbH (HyImpulse), plans the second flight of its SR75 suborbital launch vehicle from Shetland this year.

Derek Harris, head of programmes at Space Scotland, said he was not concerned about the timescale of the launch, adding that the £30m investment was a "good starter".

"The technology is difficult to master but you would prefer it to be there and be reliable so if the timescale slips into next year, I do not see that as a failure," he told BBC Radio Scotland Breakfast .

"I see that as a very well-maintained programme to make sure health and safety and reliability are at the forefront."

Harris said rain and storms could also impact the process and it was important to remain open minded.

He added: "It will take time and a lot of money but once it launches, the benefits it unlocks for Scotland and the UK will be amazing."

SaxaVord Spaceport has confirmed that it is in discussions with other companies.

The UK government said the new space strategy would "drive growth, strengthen security and back the technologies that underpin modern life".

Ministers said they wanted to create jobs and help Britain and its partners launch satellites without relying on countries "further afield".

The money for the Shetland project is part of a £148m investment across Europe which ministers said would help UK space technology firms...
body.zh: 英国政府宣布向设得兰群岛的 SaxaVord 太空港投资 3000 万英镑，作为新国家太空战略的一部分。 太空港发言人表示，这笔资金是一次“意义重大”的信任投票，将进一步释放 3000 万英镑的私人投资。 多家公司希望利用位于英国最北端安斯特的 SaxaVord 作为小型商业火箭的发射场。 一位政府发言人表示，太空对于维护国家安全来说是“一个日益重要的领域”。 SaxaVord 是英国第一个获得完全许可的太空港，并获得监管部门批准，每年最多可进行 30 次火箭发射。 该公司表示，6000万英镑的公私投资计划将用于设计和建造第二个机库和另外两个发射台。 首席执行官斯科特·哈蒙德表示，这笔资金将带领公司进入下一发展阶段。 他说：“我们正在建造太空港，这与第一次发射的次数一样多。” “我们正在努力创建一个成功、安全和可持续的企业。这是对设得兰群岛的直接投资。” 奥格斯堡火箭工厂（RFA）正在努力从英国本土进行首次垂直轨道试飞。 8 月，在 RFA 表示“遇到问题”后，SaxaVord 暂停了测试发射计划。 为期五周的“发射窗口”原定开始，在尝试飞行时会实施临时交通限制。 第二家公司 HyImpulse Technologies GmbH (HyImpulse) 计划今年从设得兰群岛进行第二次 SR75 亚轨道运载火箭飞行。 SaxaVord Spaceport 已证实正在与其他公司进行讨论。 英国政府表示，新的太空战略将“推动增长、加强安全并支持支撑现代生活的技术”。 部长们表示，他们希望创造就业机会并帮助英国及其合作伙伴发射卫星，而不依赖“更远的”国家。 设得兰群岛项目的资金是整个欧洲 1.48 亿英镑投资的一部分，部长们表示，该投资将帮助英国太空技术公司获得更多工作。 苏格兰大臣道格拉斯·亚历山大 (Douglas Alexander) 表示：“苏格兰建造的卫星数量已经超过欧洲其他任何地方，在英国政府 3000 万英镑的投资推动下，SaxaVord 现在准备提供欧洲大陆多达四分之三的轨道发射位。” 他补充说，国防、安全和经济增长是该计划的核心。 Heartland 通过其投资部门 Wild Ventures 持有 SaxaVord Spaceport 的多数股权，其首席执行官 Lise Kaae 表示：“我们非常高兴欢迎英国政府作为投资者和合作伙伴。”

reflection.en: This significant investment in the SaxaVord Spaceport represents a bold step into the future of commercial spaceflight. As this ambitious project moves forward, may its leaders commit their endeavors to Yahweh, seeking His guidance and blessing for success and for the responsible development of this new frontier. May their work be a testament to human...
reflection.zh: 这项对萨克萨沃德太空港的巨额投资，标志着商业航天领域迈出了大胆的一步。随着这个雄心勃勃的项目向前推进，愿其领导者将他们的事业托付给雅伟，寻求祂的指引和祝福，以期取得成功并负责任地开发这一新领域。愿他们的工作成为人类智慧在神圣智慧引导下的明证。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Wildlife and access boost planned for city park
title.zh: 城市公园计划增加野生动植物和游客通道

summary.en: Coventry City Council will use money from developers to improve Longford Nature Park, focusing on enhancing wildlife habitats and visitor access.
summary.zh: 考文垂市议会将利用开发商的资金来改善朗福德自然公园，重点是增强野生动植物栖息地和游客通道。

body.en:
Work is due to start improving access and habitats for wildlife at a nature park in Coventry.

Longford Nature Park is a small reserve which the city council has designated as being of high importance to the city.

The improvements will include a new boardwalk across muddy parts of the park, litter-picking and the creation of shallow wetland habitats.

The work is being funded through Section 106 money, paid by developers to councils for major development projects in the area.

Councillor Patricia Hetherton said the improvements would help protect the biodiversity already at the park and make it easier for people to get closer to nature.

"Green spaces like Longford Park play an important role in supporting our health and wellbeing," she added.

Longford Park, as well as being a nature reserve, also acts as a public path, connecting the Coventry Building Society Arena and the Coventry Canal.

The project will be delivered by the council's urban ranger team, working with volunteers from the Friends of Longfofd Park.

Follow BBC Coventry & Warwickshire on BBC Sounds , Facebook , external , X , external and Instagram , external .
body.zh: 考文垂自然公园的工作即将开始改善野生动物的通道和栖息地。 朗福德自然公园是一个小型保护区，被市议会指定为对该市非常重要的保护区。 改进措施包括在公园的泥泞部分修建一条新的木板路、清理垃圾以及建立浅层湿地栖息地。 这项工程的资金来源是第 106 条规定的资金，由开发商向该地区重大开发项目的议会支付。 议员帕特里夏·赫瑟顿 (Patricia Hetherton) 表示，这些改进将有助于保护公园现有的生物多样性，让人们更容易亲近自然。 “像朗福德公园这样的绿色空间在支持我们的健康和福祉方面发挥着重要作用，”她补充道。 朗福德公园不仅是一个自然保护区，也是一条公共道路，连接考文垂建筑协会竞技场和考文垂运河。 该项目将由市议会的城市护林员团队与朗福德公园之友的志愿者合作实施。 在 BBC Sounds、Facebook、external、X、external 和 Instagram、external 上关注 BBC Coventry & Warwickshire。

reflection.en: It is encouraging to see local authorities investing in nature, recognizing the intrinsic value of wildlife habitats. This effort to protect and enhance biodiversity in Longford Nature Park reflects a stewardship of the good creation that Yahweh declared 'very good'. May this project inspire further care for the natural world around us.
reflection.zh: 看到地方当局投资于自然，认识到野生动植物栖息地的内在价值，这是令人鼓舞的。这项在朗福德自然公园保护和增强生物多样性的努力，体现了对雅伟宣告为“甚好”的良好创造的管家职分。愿这个项目能激发对我们周围自然世界更多的关怀。

verse.textEn: God saw all that he had made, and it was very good.
verse.textZh: 神看着一切所造的都甚好。

title.en: Are rich people really worse behaved? Here’s the science – podcast
title.zh: 富人真的行为更差吗？科学是这么说的——播客

summary.en: Research suggests that wealthy individuals are more prone to unethical behavior, such as stealing sweets from children. This finding, which won an Ig Nobel prize, prompts reflection on the relationship between wealth and morality, with scientists exploring potential underlying reasons for this phenomenon.
summary.zh: 研究表明，富裕人士更容易做出不道德行为，例如偷窃儿童的糖果。这项获得搞笑诺贝尔奖的研究促使人们反思财富与道德之间的关系，科学家们正在探索这种现象背后可能的原因。

body.en: Who’s more likely to steal sweets from a child? According to science, it’s the rich. A study seemingly confirming our suspicions about the moral behaviour of the wealthy was one of the winners of the 2026 Ig Nobel prizes, which honour research that makes you laugh and then think. Science editor Ian Sample tells Madeleine Finlay what the researchers think could be behind the phenomenon, and they explore some of the other awards, including one for a surprising quality we look for in our friends and another for a biomechanical definition of kissing Rich people more likely to steal children’s sweets, finds Ig Nobel prize-winning study Support the Guardian: theguardian.com/sciencepod Continue reading...
body.zh: 谁更有可能偷孩子的糖果？根据科学，这是有钱人。一项似乎证实了我们对富人道德行为的怀疑的研究成为 2026 年搞笑诺贝尔奖的获得者之一，该奖项旨在表彰那些让你开怀大笑并引发思考的研究。科学编辑伊恩·萨普告诉玛德琳·芬利，研究人员认为这一现象背后可能存在什么，他们还探讨了其他一些奖项，其中一个奖项是为了我们在朋友身上寻找的令人惊讶的品质，另一个奖项是为了亲吻的生物力学定义，搞笑诺贝尔奖获奖研究发现有钱人更有可能偷孩子的糖果支持卫报：theguardian.com/sciencepod 继续阅读...

reflection.en: This Ig Nobel prize-winning study humorously highlights a potential disconnect between wealth and ethical conduct, suggesting that affluence might correlate with a greater willingness to transgress. It prompts us to consider the societal implications of such findings and the importance of justice and mercy in all walks of life, regardless of economic status.
reflection.zh: 这项搞笑诺贝尔奖获奖研究以幽默的方式揭示了财富与道德行为之间可能存在的脱节，暗示富裕可能与更强的越轨意愿相关。它促使我们思考此类发现的社会影响，以及无论经济地位如何，在所有生活领域中公正和怜悯的重要性。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: ‘This is dangerous’: slime moulds and the bitter debate over the nature of intelligence
title.zh: “这很危险”：黏菌与关于智能本质的激烈辩论

summary.en: Scientists are debating whether simple organisms like slime molds should be considered intelligent, a discussion that could fundamentally alter our perception of the natural world and humanity's place within it. This debate has been ongoing for decades, stemming from observations of slime molds that challenge...
summary.zh: 科学家们正在争论像黏菌这样的简单生物是否应被视为“智能”，这场辩论可能会重塑我们对自然世界的理解以及我们在其中的位置。这场争论已持续数十年，源于对黏菌的观察，这些观察挑战了对智能的传统定义。

body.en: Scientists are battling over whether supposedly simple organisms should be considered ‘intelligent’. The outcome could reshape our understanding of the natural world – and our own place within it Forty years ago, as an undergraduate in Hokkaido, Toshiyuki Nakagaki came upon a lemon-yellow stain in a petri dish. That encounter turned him into a doyen of slime mould research – and fed a storm of biological and philosophical debate about the meanings of life and intelligence that persists to this day. Before, no one would have called a slime mould “intelligent”; the popular adjective, in fact, was “simple”. “A simple mass of protoplasm,” one 1895 description ran; “among the most simple of organisms”, said another. And it was hard to argue otherwise. A slime mould can appear to be just a small cell, capable only of feeding and reproducing. Simple is as simple does. Of that first meeting, Nakagaki said: “I was just impressed with how fast it moved.” Physarum polycephalum , the slime mould species in that petri dish, has a top speed of 1cm an hour. For amoebic organisms, that’s gold-medal standard. At first glance, Physarum seems to spread as irregularly as ink on blotting paper, but in fact it senses its meals of bacteria or other microbes and reaches for them with a long, thin finger of protoplasm – which not only digests its food but then forages further or pulls back into the rest of the mould. It’s impossible to watch a slime mould over many days without sensing some deliberation at play. Continue reading...
body.zh: 科学家们正在争论所谓的简单有机体是否应该被视为“智能”。这一结果可能会重塑我们对自然世界以及我们自己在其中的地位的理解。 四十年前，作为北海道的一名本科生，Toshiyuki Nakagaki 在培养皿中发现了柠檬黄色的污渍。那次遭遇使他成为粘菌研究的元老，并引发了一场关于生命和智力意义的生物学和哲学争论，这场争论一直持续到今天。以前，没有人会称粘菌为“智能”；现在，它已经成为一种智能。事实上，流行的形容词是“简单”。 1895 年的一篇描述写道：“一团简单的原生质”； “是最简单的生物体之一”，另一个人说。很难反驳其他观点。粘菌看起来只是一个小细胞，只能进食和繁殖。简单就是简单。谈到第一次会面，中垣说：“会议进展之快给我留下了深刻的印象。”多头绒泡菌 (Physarum polycephalum) 是该培养皿中的粘菌种类，其最高速度为每小时 1 厘米。对于阿米巴生物来说，这是金牌标准。乍一看，绒泡菌似乎像吸墨纸上的墨水一样不规则地传播，但事实上，它感知到了细菌或其他微生物的食物，并用细长的原生质手指触碰它们——它不仅消化了它的食物，还进一步觅食或拉回霉菌的其余部分。观察粘菌很多天，你不可能不感受到其中的深思熟虑。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The ongoing scientific debate about the intelligence of slime molds invites us to consider the profound wisdom embedded within creation itself. As Job asks, 'But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds of the air, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or the fish in the sea, and they will explain to you.' (Job...
reflection.zh: 关于黏菌智能的科学争论，邀请我们思考造物本身所蕴含的深刻智慧。正如约伯所问：“但你且问走兽，可也教训你；飞鸟，也可告诉你；或与地说话，地也必指教你；海中的鱼，也必向你说明。”（约伯记 12:7-8）。这次探索提醒我们，雅伟精妙的设计即使在最简单的生命形式中也得以展现，只要我们愿意观察和学习，就能从中获得教诲。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Author Correction: Contrasting roles of histone 3 lysine 27 demethylases in acute lymphoblastic leukaemia
title.zh: 作者勘误：组蛋白3赖氨酸27去甲基化酶在急性淋巴细胞白血病中的对比作用

summary.en: An author correction is published for a study in Nature concerning the contrasting roles of histone 3 lysine 27 demethylases in acute lymphoblastic leukaemia, with the publication details provided.
summary.zh: 《自然》杂志发表了关于组蛋白3赖氨酸27去甲基化酶在急性淋巴细胞白血病中对比作用的研究的作者勘误，并提供了出版详情。

reflection.en: Scientific research, like the correction published here, is a testament to humanity's capacity to observe and understand the intricate systems of creation. Through careful study and revision, we gain deeper insights into the complex mechanisms of life, reflecting the wisdom inherent in the natural world. As Job asks, 'But ask the animals, and they will...
reflection.zh: 科学研究，如同此处发表的勘误，证明了人类观察和理解生命复杂系统的能力。通过细致的研究和修正，我们对生命复杂的机制有了更深入的认识，这反映了自然界固有的智慧。 正如约伯所问：“但你且问走兽，可也教导你；飞鸟，也可告诉你；或与地说话，地就必指教你；海中的鱼，也必向你说明。”这种对知识的不懈追求，即使是通过修正，也揭示了所有生命中深刻的秩序和设计。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Put patients at the centre of medical AI governance
title.zh: 将患者置于医疗人工智能治理的中心

summary.en: An editorial in Nature argues for centering patients in the governance of artificial intelligence (AI) within healthcare, emphasizing the need for ethical frameworks that prioritize human well-being and rights as AI becomes more integrated into medical practices.
summary.zh: 《自然》杂志的一篇社论主张在医疗保健领域的人工智能（AI）治理中以患者为中心，强调随着人工智能越来越多地融入医疗实践，需要制定符合伦理的框架来优先考虑人类的福祉和权利。

reflection.en: As artificial intelligence advances into complex fields like healthcare, the question of what constitutes 'intelligence' and 'personhood' becomes increasingly relevant. Genesis 1:27 reminds us that humanity is uniquely created in the image of God, a foundational truth that should guide our development and governance of powerful technologies like AI,...
reflection.zh: 随着人工智能在医疗保健等复杂领域不断发展，关于“智能”和“人格”的定义问题变得越来越重要。创世记 1:27 提醒我们，人类是按照雅伟的形象独特创造的，这一根本真理应该指导我们开发和治理像人工智能这样强大的技术，确保它们服务于人类尊严，而不是削弱它。

verse.textEn: So God created mankind in his own image, in the image of God he created them; male and female he created them.
verse.textZh: 神就照着自己的形象造人，乃是照着他的形象造男造女。

title.en: Nepal disaster is a wake-up call to take compound climate risks seriously
title.zh: 尼泊尔灾难敲响警钟：认真对待复合气候风险

summary.en: A recent disaster in Nepal, exacerbated by compound climate risks, serves as a stark warning that the interconnected and cascading effects of climate change demand serious attention and proactive measures.
summary.zh: 尼泊尔最近发生的一场灾难，由于复合气候风险的加剧，敲响了严峻的警钟，表明气候变化的相互关联和连锁效应需要认真对待和积极应对。

reflection.en: The report from Nepal speaks to a world groaning under the weight of climate change, a reality echoed in Romans 8:22. Creation itself, in its intricate systems, cries out under the strain of human impact and escalating disasters. May we heed these warnings and work towards healing and restoration, recognizing our deep connection to the earth and its future.
reflection.zh: 来自尼泊尔的报道，呼应了罗马书8章22节中“万物都在一同叹息，一同疼痛，直到如今”的景象。受人类活动和日益加剧的灾难所累，受造界本身正在承受重负而发出呻吟。愿我们警醒，并致力于修复与重建，认识到我们与大地及其未来的深层联系。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Sideline vested interests to reform China’s research
title.zh: 排除既得利益，改革中国科研

summary.en: Nature, Published online: 08 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02797-7 Sideline vested interests to reform China’s research
summary.zh: 《自然》杂志，2026年9月8日在线发表；doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02797-7 排除既得利益，改革中国科研

reflection.en: Scientific research, as highlighted in this Nature editorial, is a noble pursuit. The quest to understand the world around us, to uncover its secrets, and to push the boundaries of knowledge is a testament to human curiosity and ingenuity. This pursuit is not merely about accumulating facts, but about the inherent glory and dignity found in discovery...
reflection.zh: 正如《自然》杂志的这篇社论所强调的，科学研究是一项崇高的事业。探索我们周围的世界，揭开它的奥秘，并拓展知识的边界，是人类好奇心和创造力的证明。这种追求不仅仅是积累事实，更是关于发现本身固有的荣耀和尊严，反映了一种等待被理解的神圣秩序。

verse.textEn: It is the glory of God to conceal a matter; to search out a matter is the glory of kings.
verse.textZh: 将事隐秘乃神的荣耀；将事察清乃君王的荣耀。

title.en: Limit bets on clinical-trial outcomes being placed on prediction markets
title.zh: 在预测市场上对临床试验结果下注受限

summary.en: The use of prediction markets to bet on the outcomes of clinical trials is becoming more common, but concerns are being raised about the potential for these markets to influence or be influenced by the trials themselves.
summary.zh: 利用预测市场对临床试验结果下注的做法日益普遍，但人们对这些市场可能影响或被试验本身影响的潜在风险表示担忧。

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of technology and data analysis, as seen in the use of prediction markets for clinical trials, reflects a world where knowledge is indeed increasing. As Daniel prophesied, 'many will run to and fro, and knowledge shall increase.' This surge in information and predictive power calls us to seek wisdom and discernment, ensuring our...
reflection.zh: 正如但以理所预言的，“必有多人来往奔走，知识就必增长”。科技和数据分析的飞速发展，例如在临床试验中使用预测市场，正体现了知识的快速增长。这种信息和预测能力的激增，要求我们寻求智慧和分辨力，确保我们对知识的追求能够服务于人类的福祉和道德的完整性。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Gaps in evidence on vaccinating badgers against TB, researchers say
title.zh: 研究人员称，为獾接种疫苗防治牛结核病证据存在不足

summary.en: Researchers are calling for more monitoring of how badger vaccinations affect bovine tuberculosis and for a review of the existing evidence, stating that significant gaps in knowledge reduce the effectiveness of this disease control method.
summary.zh: 研究人员呼吁加强对獾疫苗接种对牛结核病影响的监测，并审查现有证据，指出知识和证据上的重大差距降低了这种疾病控制方法的有效性。

body.en:
There are "significant gaps" in knowledge and evidence about the effect of vaccinating badgers in Wales against bovine tuberculosis (TB), according to researchers.

A team from the British Ecological Society's Wales policy group, along with staff from Cardiff and Aberystwyth universities, argue the gaps reduce the effectiveness of this method of trying to deal with the disease.

Vaccination is part of a programme to eradicate bovine TB in Wales, but it is a controversial topic.

The Welsh government said it was "renewing" its approach to eradicating bovine TB.

There have been calls for alternative methods to vaccination for controlling the infection among cattle, such as badger culling, as they can carry the disease and transmit it to cattle.

Cattle are regularly tested for the presence of the infection and are slaughtered if they are found to be carriers.

They are calling for increased monitoring of the vaccination's impact, a review of the evidence, and collaboration with farmers "to ensure the greatest possible impact" from the programmes.

In their policy briefing, they say "major questions remain about how many badgers are being vaccinated, what impact vaccinating badgers is having on disease levels in cattle, and how confidence in vaccination can be improved among farmers and veterinary professionals".

Dr Niall McKeown, a lecturer in the department of life sciences at Aberystwyth University and vice-chair of the British Ecological Society's Wales policy group, said the infection "remains one of the biggest animal health challenges facing Wales".

"Badger vaccination should not be presented as a stand-alone route to eradicating bovine tuberculosis," said McKeown.

"There is strong evidence that BCG vaccination protects badgers, but evidence that operational vaccination programmes reduce disease in cattle remains limited.

"Any cattle-level benefit is likely to depend on sustained and sufficiently extensive vaccination coverage alongside effective cattle controls."

He emphasised it was not simply more vaccination that was needed "but vaccination that is better targeted, measured and evaluated".

"By combining non-invasive genetic monitoring with sett surveys, camera traps and movement data, we can estimate local badger numbers, check the proportion of the population reached and identify significant gaps," he added.

A spokesperson for the Welsh government said: "We are renewing our approach to eradicating bovine TB in Wales, focusing on three main elements: cattle, people, and wildlife.

"This work will be evidence-based and science-led, taking into account advice from the programme board and the technical advisory group, while ensuring that value for money remains a core consideration in decision-making."

Last month, Llyr Gruffydd, the...
body.zh: 研究人员表示，关于威尔士獾疫苗接种对牛结核病（TB）效果的了解和证据存在“重大差距”。 英国生态学会威尔士政策小组的一个团队以及卡迪夫大学和阿伯里斯特威斯大学的工作人员认为，这些差距降低了这种应对这种疾病的方法的有效性。 疫苗接种是威尔士根除牛结核病计划的一部分，但这是一个有争议的话题。 威尔士政府表示正在“更新”根除牛结核病的方法。 有人呼吁采用疫苗接种以外的替代方法来控制牛群感染，例如扑杀獾，因为它们可以携带疾病并将其传播给牛群。 定期对牛进行检测以确定是否存在感染，如果发现是携带者，则将其宰杀。 他们呼吁加强对疫苗接种影响的监测、对证据的审查以及与农民的合作，“以确保该计划产生最大可能的影响”。 他们在政策简报中表示，“主要问题仍然是有多少獾正在接种疫苗，獾接种疫苗对牛的疾病水平有何影响，以及如何提高农民和兽医专业人员对疫苗接种的信心”。 阿伯里斯特威斯大学生命科学系讲师、英国生态学会威尔士政策小组副主席尼尔·麦基翁博士表示，这种感染“仍然是威尔士面临的最大动物健康挑战之一”。 “獾疫苗接种不应作为根除牛结核病的独立途径，”麦基翁说。 “有强有力的证据表明卡介苗疫苗接种可以保护獾，但有效的疫苗接种计划减少牛疾病的证据仍然有限。 “任何牛水平的效益都可能取决于持续且足够广泛的疫苗接种覆盖率以及有效的牛控制。” 他强调，需要的不仅仅是更多的疫苗接种，“而是更有针对性、更好地衡量和评估的疫苗接种”。 “通过将非侵入性基因监测与设置调查、相机陷阱和运动数据相结合，我们可以估计当地獾的数量，检查达到的种群比例并确定显着的差距，”他补充道。 威尔士政府发言人表示：“我们正在更新根除威尔士牛结核病的方法，重点关注三个主要因素：牛、人和野生动物。 “这项工作将以证据为基础，以科学为主导，同时考虑项目委员会和技术咨询小组的建议，同时确保物有所值仍然是决策的核心考虑因素。” 上个月，Llyr Gruffydd...

reflection.en: The scientific community's call for more evidence before fully embracing a policy, even one intended for good, echoes the wisdom of seeking counsel. When implementing solutions, especially those with potential controversy, a thorough understanding and ongoing evaluation are crucial for true effectiveness and responsible stewardship.
reflection.zh: 科学界呼吁在全面推行一项政策（即使是旨在造福的政策）之前，需要更多的证据，这呼应了寻求忠告的智慧。在实施解决方案时，特别是那些可能引起争议的方案，透彻的理解和持续的评估对于真正的有效性和负责任的管理至关重要。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

body.en: GLP-1 medications have been a gamechanger in the fight against obesity. But for a minority of patients, their impact is negligible. Why? When Mercedes was told by her doctor that she could be prescribed GLP-1 weight loss jabs in 2024, she broke down. “[When] she said yes, I cried in her office. And I didn’t really stop crying for a week,” she said. “Finally, after being overweight my entire life, this was going to save me. My struggle, my burden, my shame was finally going to come to an end.” Continue reading...
body.zh: GLP-1 药物已成为对抗肥胖的游戏规则改变者。但对于少数患者来说，其影响可以忽略不计。为什么？当梅赛德斯的医生告诉她可以在 2024 年接受 GLP-1 减肥注射时，她崩溃了。 “当她答应的时候，我在她的办公室里哭了。整整一周我都没有真正停止哭泣，”她说。 “最后，在我一生都超重之后，这将拯救我。我的挣扎、我的负担、我的耻辱终于要结束了。”继续阅读...

When these treatments prove ineffective, the disappointment can be crushing, leading to deep emotional distress. In these moments, the psalmist's plea to his soul, 'Why, my soul, are you downcast? Why so disturbed within me?',...
reflection.zh: 对一些人来说，减肥药物的承诺带来了巨大的希望，可能结束他们一生与羞耻和负担的斗争。当这些治疗无效时，失望可能是毁灭性的，导致深切的情感痛苦。在这些时刻，诗篇作者对他灵魂的呼求‘我的心哪，你为何忧闷？为何在我里面烦躁？’，与对抗绝望的深刻内心挣扎产生了共鸣。

The company behind ChatGPT said it had cracked the Navier-Stokes problem, one of seven Millennium Prize Problems published by the Clay Mathematics Institute to highlight some of the biggest unsolved puzzles in the field.
